00285ea73aa3.en: Eori, unfazed by all the blood, steps toward him. "I finally found you! Let's go back home, Harry!" Magi, firm, her bow drawn and pointed at the ground: "He's mine until I turn him in to the Embassy!" Eori realizes she's an adventurer. "All right, fine! Do what you must, but I'll follow you there."
00285ea73aa3.t: 埃奥丽对满地的血毫不在意，朝他走过去。“我终于找到你了！我们回家吧，哈利！”玛姬坚定地拉着弓，箭指着地面：“在我把他交给大使馆之前，他是我的！”埃奥丽意识到她是个冒险者。“好吧，行！做你该做的，但我会跟着你去那里。”

00b7aef1931a.en: He looks around and sees things like the ones Eori had. He thinks Eori has caught him, and tries to break free, but he's locked up tight. No! This has to be a dream! Then he remembers Morika, in full armor, beating the shit out of him and extracting everything he knew.
00b7aef1931a.t: 他环顾四周，看到了和埃奥丽那里一样的东西。他以为埃奥丽抓住了他，试图挣脱，但他被锁得死死的。不！这一定是一场梦！然后他想起了莫里卡，全副武装，把他揍了个半死，逼问出他知道的一切。

0318e3518f0d.en: The contractor leaves. Ryo: "Have you found your girls yet?" "I'm working on it. I only have time to review one or two a day." "Hmmm. Can I watch the auditions?" "But you can't participate, or I won't be able to review their fuckability." "In all my years, I've never heard that. Seems legit."
0318e3518f0d.t: 承包商离开了。亮：“你找到你的姑娘们了吗？”“我正在找。我一天只有时间面试一两个。”“嗯——。我能看面试吗？”“但你不能参与，否则我就没法评估她们的可操度了。”“我活了这么多年，还从来没听过这个。听起来挺靠谱的。”

034e6d9d6075.en: Eori: "YOU SET ME UP!" Coema chuckles in the silent room. "The plan was for you to do that to Neferteri, not to me." "THEN WHY DID YOU MAKE NARI GELS OUT OF HARRY?" Coema raises a hand. "Again, we distributed them, but didn't produce them." "IT DOESN'T MATTER! WHY DIDN'T YOU TELL ME?"
034e6d9d6075.t: 埃奥丽：“你陷害我！”科埃玛在寂静的房间里轻笑。“计划是让你对奈菲尔特丽这么做，而不是对我。”“那你为什么用哈利做纳里凝胶？”科埃玛举起一只手。“我再说一遍，我们只是分销，没有生产。”“那不重要！你为什么不告诉我？”

03766011934c.en: Harry, in a setup very much like the one Eori imprisoned him in
03766011934c.t: 哈利被关在一个和埃奥丽囚禁他的地方非常相似的布置里

049e37fc5b71.en: "But! But!—" Eiri shuts up and swallows her tears. "I need to go talk with Neferteri." "You sure? You do realize what'll happen when Neferteri finds out I'm holding the Red Winga bandit who stole Harry away from Eori." Arukia: "I fled from them." "Doesn't matter. I can't take everything you said at face value either."
049e37fc5b71.t: “可是！可是！——”艾莉闭上嘴，咽下了眼泪。“我需要去和奈菲尔特丽谈谈。”“你确定？你知道当奈菲尔特丽发现我扣着那个从埃奥丽身边偷走哈利的雷德温加强盗时，会发生什么吗？”阿露琪娅：“我是从他们那里逃出来的。”“那不重要。我也不能完全相信你说的话。”

0540e577f755.en: "Princess Eori! You must stop at once!" The same citizen appears again. "FUCK OFF! THIS PIECE OF SHIT IS NOT HARRY!" Eori has had it. The citizen looks around, gravely concerned. "Princess Eori! This is a trap!" He reaches for his sword, but stops when he sees Magi aiming at him instead. Magi, angry: "Who are you?"
0540e577f755.t: “埃奥丽公主！您必须马上住手！”那个市民又出现了。“滚开！这坨屎不是哈利！”埃奥丽受够了。那个市民环顾四周，神情凝重。“埃奥丽公主！这是个圈套！”他伸手去拔剑，但看到玛姬转而瞄准了他，便停了下来。玛姬生气地问：“你是谁？”

060df52879e7.en: She backs away quickly and keeps walking down the main road. As she walks, her eyes grow heavy again. She slaps herself, drawing everyone's attention; thinking she's crazy, they all leave her be. The girl in pink wakes up a bit and speed-walks on.
060df52879e7.t: 她赶紧后退，继续沿着主路走。走着走着，她的眼皮又沉了起来。她扇了自己一巴掌，引来了所有人的注意；他们以为她疯了，都没去管她。粉衣女孩清醒了一点，快步往前走。

065d856b9344.t: 第 14 卷 - 纳里凝胶诱饵

06ac7e0d2903.t: 第 1 章 - 承办宴席

06c67eb3ad5c.en: Ryo hugs them both. "I'd take both, but Katsumi has a dream of her own, and this place will help her get there. All right, let's take a tour." The assistant shows them around the dump.
06c67eb3ad5c.t: 亮抱住她们俩。“我两个都想要，但胜美有她自己的梦想，这个地方会帮她实现。好了，我们参观一下吧。”助手带他们参观了这个破地方。

0819115614fc.en: She knows that if she shows up, she'll be discovered and bring harm to her family. Who could she turn to? She fucked over everyone she knew, burning all her bridges. She hugs her baby Bruntos tight.
0819115614fc.t: 她知道如果她露面，就会被发现，给家人带来伤害。她能求助于谁呢？她坑了她认识的每一个人，断了自己所有的后路。她紧紧抱住她的布伦托斯宝宝。

08ce4219204b.en: Harry looks at the passed-out Magi, her shivering body, her bluish lips and nails. Not so scary-looking now.
08ce4219204b.t: 哈利看着昏过去的玛姬，她发抖的身体，她发青的嘴唇和指甲。现在看起来没那么吓人了。

09a164da99bf.en: Desmond sees her chewing slow down and her head dip forward. With the next blink, she's out cold, falling forward onto the table and spilling her drink. "Hey? Are you okay?" No response. He touches her soft shoulder; nothing. That doesn't look comfortable. He grabs a pillow, and as he tilts her back onto it, she startles awake and slaps his hand away.
09a164da99bf.t: 德斯蒙德看到她咀嚼的速度慢了下来，头往前垂。下一次眨眼时，她就睡死过去了，向前倒在桌上，打翻了她的饮料。“嘿？你还好吗？”没有回应。他碰了碰她柔软的肩膀；没反应。那样看起来不太舒服。他拿来一个枕头，在他把她往后靠到枕头上时，她猛地惊醒，拍开了他的手。

0a2d47c57c72.en: "What do you mean?" She lifts the free bread. "This! You're eating this too!" "There are no leftovers, so this is what I'm eating." "Don't you make, like, fifteen Pearls a day?" "Yeah, but I live here too, so I pay ten a day, and I'm using the rest to pay off this uniform." She chows down on more bread. And I made 2 Pearls in the past two days.
0a2d47c57c72.t: “你是什么意思？”她举起那块免费的面包。“这个！你也在吃这个！”“没有剩菜了，所以我就吃这个。”“你不是一天能挣大概十五颗珀尔吗？”“是啊，但我也住在这里，所以每天要付十颗，剩下的用来还这身制服的钱。”她又大口吃了些面包。而我过去两天才挣了 2 颗珀尔。

0a960f9760e1.en: Ryo: "I think she's coming. Talk about something else." They pass by "Neferteri" (it's someone else: another of Neferteri's decoys, like the five Morikas), and Eori makes deep eye contact.
0a960f9760e1.t: 亮：“我觉得她来了。聊点别的。”他们经过“奈菲尔特丽”（那是别人：奈菲尔特丽的又一个诱饵，就像那五个莫里卡一样），埃奥丽和她深深地对视了一眼。

0aa335dfa53b.en: The door opens. Eiri runs to Arukia, hugs her and starts crying. Sora hangs back, noticing the disapproval in Coema's eyes. Coema puts down her tea. "Eiri, you plan on cuddling a traitor all day?" Eiri looks at her in disbelief. Arukia looks down. "It's true." Coema: "Tell it all again." Sora excuses herself, assuming this conversation isn't for her. "Hold up there, young lady. You're gonna listen to all of it too."
0aa335dfa53b.t: 门开了。艾莉跑向阿露琪娅，抱住她哭了起来。索拉留在后面，注意到了科埃玛眼中的不满。科埃玛放下茶杯。“艾莉，你打算抱着一个叛徒一整天吗？”艾莉难以置信地看着她。阿露琪娅低下头。“是真的。”科埃玛：“再全部讲一遍。”索拉告退了，以为这场谈话不是给她听的。“等一下，小姑娘。你也要全部听着。”

0caafd2448b0.en: Morika, in full body armor, ready to fight the four Cruros defending Arukia
0caafd2448b0.t: 全副武装的莫里卡准备和保护阿露琪娅的四个克鲁罗战斗

0ccfe277a3b6.en: Harry, straining his eyes, carefully flips things in his wok. "They kicked me out of the kitchen, but I've been watching them. I think I'm getting the hang of it now." Magi, hiding her shivering, asks point-blank: "Desmond from Rebula. How did you get that name?"
0ccfe277a3b6.t: 哈利眯着眼睛，小心翼翼地在他的炒锅里翻炒着东西。“他们把我赶出了厨房，但我一直在看他们做。我想我现在掌握诀窍了。”玛姬掩饰着自己的颤抖，直截了当地问：“雷布拉的德斯蒙德。你是怎么得到这个名字的？”

0d04efac6538.t: 第 3 章 - 阿露琪娅的机会。

0e13bdb9895c.en: {WIP-embassyClerk}, the sweet old clerk from that morning: "You look terrible, honey." "I just want to return this badge, and deposit these Pearls into the guild." Magi shows her own badge next. "Blue-Flower-Red-Bone? Oh! What a delight! How's your father? He was quite the gentleman, even back when he was an Amethyst, like you."
0e13bdb9895c.t: {WIP-embassyClerk}，那天早上那位和蔼的老文员：“你看起来糟透了，亲爱的。”“我只是想还这块身份牌，再把这些珀尔存进公会。”玛姬接着出示了她自己的身份牌。“布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩？哦！真让人高兴！你父亲好吗？他可真是个绅士，就连他还是阿米西斯特级的时候也是，就像你一样。”

0ed597954be8.en: Rounding a corner on her way to buy a drink, Eori sees Harry carrying a box; Magi in the background
0ed597954be8.t: 在去买饮料的路上转过一个拐角时，埃奥丽看到哈利扛着一个箱子；玛姬在背景里

109e5661ac67.en: Yosuke watches Magi pull the bloody arrow out of Harry's back
109e5661ac67.t: 洋介看着玛姬把带血的箭从哈利背上拔出来

10ab9d030c18.en: Magi feels the tension. She wants to capture Harry, but what if he's just a look-alike? She takes too long to decide, and the restaurant's light goes out.
10ab9d030c18.t: 玛姬感到紧张。她想抓住哈利，但万一他只是个长得像的人呢？她犹豫得太久，餐馆的灯灭了。

116a9083aec7.en: Magi turns in her quest at the Embassy

14e83042280e.en: Harry's memory snaps back. He looks around for her, ready to run. "Where's Eori?" "She left already. A guy named Morika took her away." Harry sighs in relief, then his mind clicks. Wait. Why didn't my badge light up?
14e83042280e.t: 哈利的记忆一下子回来了。他环顾四周寻找她，准备逃跑。“埃奥丽在哪儿？”“她已经走了。一个叫莫里卡的人把她带走了。”哈利松了一口气，然后脑子里咯噔一下。等等。我的身份牌为什么没亮？

15fd93a76c6f.en: Harry tries to talk. Neferteri: "Please shut this monster up!" She leaves. Morika grabs a weapon, slashes Harry near his groin, and starts collecting his blood. Harry, furious, tries to break free and use the fire, but nothing comes out. He passes out.
15fd93a76c6f.t: 哈利想说话。奈菲尔特丽：“请让这个怪物闭嘴！”她离开了。莫里卡拿起一件武器，在哈利的腹股沟附近划了一刀，开始收集他的血。哈利怒不可遏，试图挣脱，想用火，但什么都没出来。他昏了过去。

16f6ea400c0a.en: Eori changes her appearance. "If that's what you want, mother, then I can play this game too." Outside, the town crier keeps going: "Desmond! Come back to us! Yosuke and the team."
16f6ea400c0a.t: 埃奥丽改变了自己的外貌。“如果这就是你想要的，母亲，那我也可以玩这个游戏。”外面，城镇报信人还在喊着：“德斯蒙德！回到我们身边！洋介和团队。”

16f8b0ea8361.en: Eori flips her shit and goes back to her dorm. She remembers Coema's letter, and it clicks: someone is holding Harry hostage, using his fake body. She's pissed she didn't heal him, or interrogate him. She "wears" a fake skin and mask made from her roommate, {WIP-eoriRoommate}, so she can escape looking like her.
16f8b0ea8361.t: 埃奥丽大发脾气，回到了宿舍。她想起了科埃玛的信，一下子想通了：有人把哈利扣为人质，用的是他的假身体。她很生气自己当时没有治好他，也没有审问他。她用室友 {WIP-eoriRoommate} 做成的假皮和面具“穿”上，好装成她的样子逃出去。

1af6bbec6308.en: Chapter 2 - Stocking the fires of love.
1af6bbec6308.t: 第 2 章 - 给爱火添柴。

1c648a09c812.en: Ryo and Katsuki, undercover, at a Sanbi bar; Arukia drinks out in the open; sketchy people at two of the tables
1c648a09c812.t: 乔装的亮和胜希在桑比的一家酒吧；阿露琪娅在明处喝酒；两张桌子旁坐着形迹可疑的人

1c957865b9c2.en: Eori, near dawn, jacked, flies over the hideout where she once kept Harry
1c957865b9c2.t: 快黎明时，肌肉暴涨的埃奥丽飞过她曾经囚禁哈利的藏身处上空

1cf72788ec2f.en: They talk about the opportunity. Yosuke tells Dalila not to steal food, or he'll punish her this time. Dalila feels the stress.
1cf72788ec2f.t: 他们谈论着这个机会。洋介告诉达莉拉不许偷吃，否则这次他会惩罚她。达莉拉感到了压力。

1d0d758dc610.en: People are staring at this pink adventurer. Magi jumps up—"I'M SORRY!"—and takes off running, clutching her green bag as she hears them murmur, baffled. "HEY! YOU LEFT YOUR BOW AND BAG!" She stops: she's holding her green bag, but she left everything else behind. She walks back in shame.
1d0d758dc610.t: 人们盯着这个粉色的冒险者。玛姬跳起来——“对不起！”——抱着她的绿色袋子拔腿就跑，听到他们困惑地低语。“嘿！你的弓和包落下了！”她停下了：她拿着绿色的袋子，但其他东西全落下了。她羞愧地走了回去。

1d91f6d8364f.en: More of Magi on the job. She starts to fall asleep and reaches for her Mind Quicken (another spelling of Time Quicken), but she's run out. She falls asleep, falls out of the tree, and wakes up surrounded by Bagarisas.
1d91f6d8364f.t: 更多玛姬工作的场景。她开始犯困，伸手去拿她的迈恩德奎肯（泰姆奎肯的另一种拼法），但已经用完了。她睡着了，从树上摔了下来，醒来时周围全是巴加里萨。

1dc2058e48bc.en: Ryo: "This is the best you found?" His assistant, {WIP-ryoAssistant}: "That's the best I could find. If you'd given me 5 more Sapphires, I could have haggled for something else." "Well, I do like a challenge. Anyway, I guess we should introduce ourselves." He does.
1dc2058e48bc.t: 亮：“这就是你找到的最好的？”他的助手 {WIP-ryoAssistant}：“这是我能找到的最好的了。如果你再多给我 5 颗萨菲尔，我还能讲价换个别的。”“嗯，我确实喜欢挑战。总之，我想我们该做个自我介绍。”他做了自我介绍。

22a011d209ae.en: Coema takes a sip of tea. "That's quite the story you've got there. And Eiri never caught on to your behavior?" Arukia, holding her baby tight: "Never." "You know why?" "She's too kind." "And you know who isn't?" "The previous King's maid. You."
22a011d209ae.t: 科埃玛啜了一口茶。“你讲的故事可真够精彩的。艾莉从来没察觉你的所作所为？”阿露琪娅紧紧抱着她的宝宝：“从来没有。”“你知道为什么吗？”“她太善良了。”“那你知道谁不善良吗？”“前任国王女仆。你。”

23470e0b7e18.en: Coema: "She's trying to thin the herd! Everyone, pick a cart and follow it to its destination. Try to peek from afar, then come back to the meeting spot so we can decide which place to raid." Eori swoops off after a cart heading right. Ryo: "I guess I'll take left." Coema: "Magi, let's follow the ones going north?" "Sure."
23470e0b7e18.t: 科埃玛：“她想分散我们！大家各选一辆车，跟着它到目的地。试着从远处偷看，然后回到集合点，我们再决定突袭哪个地方。”埃奥丽俯冲下去，追着一辆往右走的车。亮：“那我就跟左边的吧。”科埃玛：“玛姬，我们跟往北走的那些？”“好。”

24d2f11ad16a.en: Magi, tired, returns the badge to the clerk
24d2f11ad16a.t: 疲惫的玛姬把身份牌还给文员

255f7340bf18.en: Magi sits down again and looks at her tattered clothes. "I'm sorry, Jonem." (Jonem is her little brother.)
255f7340bf18.t: 玛姬又坐了下来，看着自己破破烂烂的衣服。“对不起，乔内姆。”（乔内姆是她的弟弟。）

25c09a2844a9.en: Magi, alone, at an end table by the wall in a loud tavern
25c09a2844a9.t: 玛姬独自坐在一家吵闹酒馆靠墙的一张角落桌子旁

25d932dbb3da.en: Eori: "What the fuck do you want?" Magi: "I borrowed the badge from the clerk this morning! I've been tracking him since yesterday!" Eori looks confused. "What does that have to do with anything? I'm the princess of Sanbi! Harry is mine!" "Step away, or I'll shoot him!"
25d932dbb3da.t: 埃奥丽：“你他妈想干嘛？”玛姬：“我今天早上从文员那里借了身份牌！我从昨天就开始追踪他了！”埃奥丽看起来很困惑。“这和这件事有什么关系？我是桑比的公主！哈利是我的！”“退后，否则我就射他！”

26b7a865656c.en: Morika, in full armor, and Neferteri come to see Harry
26b7a865656c.t: 全副武装的莫里卡和奈菲尔特丽来看哈利

28e63356b350.en: "He's mine!" A cutesy voice breaks up the lovely (if one can call it that) situation.
28e63356b350.t: “他是我的！”一个可爱的声音打断了这个美好的（如果能这么叫的话）场面。

29717b83b04d.en: Ryo and Katsuki at lunch in a restaurant north of Forway; Katsuki devours even more Barinas
29717b83b04d.t: 亮和胜希在福威北边的一家餐馆吃午饭；胜希吞下了更多的巴里纳

2b1602d7b8aa.en: They ask why she took so long. She explains that Morika was being extra careful, but she confirmed Neferteri was inside the building in {WIP-neferteriVillage}.
2b1602d7b8aa.t: 他们问她为什么花了这么长时间。她解释说莫里卡格外小心，但她证实了奈菲尔特丽就在 {WIP-neferteriVillage} 的那栋建筑里。

2b3317d1e039.en: Ryo does the budget with Katsuki while Katsumi shows off her things, construction going on around them
2b3317d1e039.t: 亮和胜希一起做预算，胜美在炫耀她的东西，周围正在施工

2def99f16c1c.en: Magi, arrow ready; Eori, sweaty, holds a sweaty Harry against the wall and glares at Magi
2def99f16c1c.t: 玛姬搭好了箭；满身大汗的埃奥丽把满身大汗的哈利按在墙上，瞪着玛姬

2f69411edb18.en: Harry falls forward, but catches himself and keeps stumbling on, a trail of blood droplets following him out the door and into the crowd. "Princess Eori! You can't leave the game!" A citizen with a sword on his back appears on the stairs. Eori looks at him, flips him the bird, and takes off after Harry.
2f69411edb18.t: 哈利向前倒去，但稳住了身子，继续跌跌撞撞地往前跑，身后一路滴着血，出了门，冲进了人群。“埃奥丽公主！您不能离开比赛！”一个背着剑的市民出现在楼梯上。埃奥丽看着他，冲他竖了个中指，追着哈利跑了。

2fc8fec232d7.en: Arukia, hiding her face, with the Bruntos at a nari gel stand; among the options, she sees Harry
2fc8fec232d7.t: 阿露琪娅遮着脸，带着布伦托斯来到一个纳里凝胶摊位；在各种选择中，她看到了哈利

30c80a25e7c4.en: Hanako and Mimi come to Harry's rescue. Hanako offers Eori her hand. "We're sorry for the trouble he caused." "HE BETTER FUCKING BE!" Eori, realizing she's at a stalemate of strength with Harry, stops forcing herself on him and slaps Hanako's hand away as she stands up.
30c80a25e7c4.t: 花子和咪咪赶来救哈利。花子向埃奥丽伸出手。“很抱歉他给您添了麻烦。”“他他妈的最好抱歉！”埃奥丽意识到自己和哈利在力气上僵持不下，便不再硬压着他，站起来时拍开了花子的手。

31626ae26453.en: The teacher drags her along to help with a contract; Eori snaps at the teacher, and the teacher snaps back
31626ae26453.t: 老师拉着她去帮忙履行契约；埃奥丽冲老师发火，老师也冲她发火

33813ba6c9c2.en: Magi smiles, but her sad expression blurs the smile. She watches Desmond, the white-haired guy, help someone with their bill, grab something to drink, then bring all the leftover Breadplates over to her. He looks familiar— Desmond starts chowing down on them too. The pink adventurer looks at him, confused, then angry. "Are you mocking me, like everyone else?"
33813ba6c9c2.t: 玛姬笑了，但她悲伤的表情让笑容变得模糊。她看着德斯蒙德，那个白发的家伙，帮人结账、拿了点喝的，然后把所有剩下的面包盘都拿到她这里来。他看起来很眼熟——德斯蒙德也开始大口吃起来。粉衣冒险者看着他，先是困惑，然后生气了。“你是在嘲笑我吗，像其他人一样？”

3392d034e47b.en: Magi gets ready to sleep somewhere, close to midnight
3392d034e47b.t: 快到午夜时，玛姬准备在某个地方睡觉

34419dad193c.en: Harry, confused, and Magi sit across from each other, eating Breadplates together
34419dad193c.t: 困惑的哈利和玛姬面对面坐着，一起吃面包盘

34f738c8eee7.en: Older lady: "Not ordering anything again, pink adventurer?" Magi shakes her head. "Poor you." Magi ends up falling asleep, and suddenly remembers the Gandew duel at the end of Vol 1, which she watched from the background (she has been in the background of the illustrations): she saw Harry's old, fatter form. He has changed a lot, but he still holds some semblance. "HARRY!" The outburst draws several people's attention. A drunk guy: "Hey, baby, toss Harry aside. Come spend the night with me instead!" Magi, disgusted, pushes him aside and leaves the tavern.
34f738c8eee7.t: 年长的女士：“又什么都不点吗，粉衣冒险者？”玛姬摇摇头。“可怜的孩子。”玛姬最后睡着了，突然想起了 Vol 1 结尾的那场甘杜决斗，她当时在背景里看着（她一直出现在插图的背景里）：她看到了哈利以前更胖的样子。他变了很多，但还保留着几分相似。“哈利！”这一声喊引起了好几个人的注意。一个醉汉：“嘿，宝贝，把哈利扔到一边。来陪我过夜吧！”玛姬恶心地把他推开，离开了酒馆。

374362fc24cd.en: Harry tries to use his Bagarisa fire, but nothing. He makes a racket trying to break free, until two people come downstairs.
374362fc24cd.t: 哈利试着使用他的巴加里萨之火，但什么都没有。他吵吵嚷嚷地想挣脱，直到两个人走下楼来。

375ca1cd8a84.en: Arc #4 - Fishy Conspiracy: the author's story notes (spoilers).
375ca1cd8a84.t: 第 4 弧 - 腥味的阴谋：作者的故事笔记（含剧透）。

37ac3ee3ca45.en: Coema: "Sorry to hear that. What was your guild again?" "Blue-Flower-Red-Bone." "I see. The name sounds familiar for some reason. Once this is all said and done, come see me for tea, and we can look through the Half-Cruro guild books." "Are you part of that guild?" "But of course. Kiko founded it to enlighten the lives of the smarter Cruros coming from Cruroland. Why wouldn't I want to support such a great cause?" Magi: "Sure." She looks back at the carts. While making a buttload of money. I bet you wouldn't care if the guild weren't so rich.
37ac3ee3ca45.t: 科埃玛：“听到这个我很难过。你的公会叫什么来着？”“布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩。”“我明白了。不知为什么这个名字听起来很耳熟。等这一切都结束了，来找我喝茶，我们可以翻翻哈夫·克鲁罗公会的账本。”“你是那个公会的成员？”“那当然。基科创立它是为了启迪那些从克鲁罗兰来的、比较聪明的克鲁罗的生活。我为什么不想支持这样伟大的事业呢？”玛姬：“当然。”她回头看着那些车。同时还赚得盆满钵满。我打赌如果公会没那么有钱，你才不会在乎。

381e28b232f7.en: Emelia, in the flower shop, hears from bandits that the Sanbi Kingdom has reached out to Arukia's parents
381e28b232f7.t: 艾米莉娅在花店里从强盗那里听说桑比王国联系了阿露琪娅的父母

3a43718e33ac.en: Magi keeps silent. She watches him carry the body inside, looks around for anyone else, and finds no one. She flies to the chimney of the house, where she hears a distinctly familiar voice: the voice of a queen. "Were you followed, as I expected?" Morika: "Yes, my Queen. We split up into different hideouts, as requested." Neferteri: "Thank you. Now let's find out what happened." "My Queen, forgive my question, but are you sure you want to take part in the interrogation?" "I want to see this matter resolved quickly, so yes."
3a43718e33ac.t: 玛姬保持沉默。她看着他把尸体扛进屋里，四处寻找有没有别人，一个也没找到。她飞到房子的烟囱上，在那里听到了一个明显很熟悉的声音：一位王后的声音。“正如我所料，你被跟踪了吗？”莫里卡：“是的，我的王后。我们按照吩咐分散到了不同的藏身处。”奈菲尔特丽：“谢谢你。现在我们来弄清楚发生了什么。”“我的王后，请原谅我的问题，但您确定要参加审讯吗？”“我想尽快解决这件事，所以是的。”

3aac78aacc19.en: Katsuki: "One—Arukia." Ryo looks. "She's pretty hot. No wonder the Red Winga recruited her." "One—deserter—two—why?" "Right. This seems pretty fishy, and it's not the Kingdom. I think someone might be baiting us. Look around. See anyone who stands out?" Katsuki isn't sure.
3aac78aacc19.t: 胜希：“一——阿露琪娅。”亮看过去。“她挺辣的。难怪雷德温加会招募她。”“一——逃兵——二——为什么？”“对。这看起来很可疑，而且不是王国干的。我觉得可能有人在给我们下饵。看看四周。看到有什么人特别显眼吗？”胜希不太确定。

3ad4f1b38e34.en: "HANAKO! Desmond let his new girlfriend into his room!" Dalila screams at the door. Magi, blushing red, chokes on her food trying to deny it. "I'm not—" A few coughs to clear her throat. "I'm not his girlfriend! I was hunting him down for a missing person quest!" Dalila: "Missing person? So you know who his family is?" Magi shakes her head. "I thought he was Harry from Sanbi, but the badge didn't light up."
3ad4f1b38e34.t: “花子！德斯蒙德把他的新女朋友带进他房间了！”达莉拉在门口尖叫。玛姬满脸通红，想否认却被食物呛到了。“我不是——”咳了几声清了清嗓子。“我不是他女朋友！我是在为一个失踪人口任务追捕他！”达莉拉：“失踪人口？那你知道他的家人是谁吗？”玛姬摇摇头。“我以为他是桑比的哈利，但身份牌没有亮。”

3b5d3919a804.en: Coema is the last to take off. She turns to the seven Cruros with her. "Get all the bodies back to the guild." The Cruros acknowledge it and head for the gory scene in the alley. The others take off clumsily, with Magi and Eori coaching them, and tail Morika, who throws a half-assed white sheet over Arukia's mangled body in his wagon.
3b5d3919a804.t: 科埃玛最后一个起飞。她转向和她在一起的七个克鲁罗。“把所有尸体都带回公会。”克鲁罗们领命，朝小巷里那血腥的现场走去。其他人笨手笨脚地起飞，玛姬和埃奥丽指导着他们，跟踪着莫里卡，他往他马车上阿露琪娅血肉模糊的尸体上随便盖了一块白布。

3b8aaf08f9ba.en: The vendors say it's from their distributor, and if they have a problem, they should take it up with him. They ask who he is. "A round, hairy dude called Lick, from the guild My-Veiny-Balls." (A prank name: he never reveals his real name, and refuses to sign contracts, but he's a master craftsman, so people put up with his bullshit.) The vendor laughs as Eiri and Sora walk away.
3b8aaf08f9ba.t: 摊贩们说这是从他们的经销商那里来的，如果她们有问题，应该去找他。她们问他是谁。“一个圆滚滚、毛茸茸的家伙，叫利克，来自迈维尼博尔斯公会。”（一个恶搞的名字：他从不透露自己的真名，也拒绝签契约，但他是个手艺高超的工匠，所以人们忍受他的那些狗屁。）艾莉和索拉走开时，摊贩笑了起来。

3bcaac878b97.en: Harry leaves the atelier with his clothes fixed, near sunset
3bcaac878b97.t: 快日落时，补好衣服的哈利离开了裁缝铺

3c5cd155c83d.en: Katsuki explains that she wants to buy Harry from her. Coema: "I see. So you two thought the Half-Cruro guild was making nari gels out of him?" Ryo: "Who else would go to the lengths of sending Cruros all over?" "True dat. It is our guild distributing them, but we aren't making them."
3c5cd155c83d.t: 胜希解释说她想从她那里买下哈利。科埃玛：“我明白了。所以你们俩以为是哈夫·克鲁罗公会在用他做纳里凝胶？”亮：“还有谁会费这么大劲把克鲁罗派得到处都是？”“说得对。分销的确实是我们公会，但做的不是我们。”

3cc3817d84f1.en: Ryo goes to the bar and orders five frothy beers; he grabs three, and Katsuki grabs two. He sets them on the table of a large group of Cruros, to cackles of interest and surprise. "Choose one." The Cruros are unsure; someone smacks their lips and picks one at random. Ryo grabs it and chugs it, which pisses Katsuki off.
3cc3817d84f1.t: 亮走到吧台，点了五杯泡沫丰富的啤酒；他拿了三杯，胜希拿了两杯。他把它们放在一大群克鲁罗的桌上，引来一阵感兴趣又惊讶的咯咯声。“选一杯。”克鲁罗们拿不定主意；有一个咂咂嘴，随便选了一杯。亮拿起来一饮而尽，这让胜希很生气。

3cc78b20b2cf.en: Magi, somewhat resentful, and Harry, in disbelief and deep thought, walk back, bloodied
3cc78b20b2cf.t: 有些愤愤不平的玛姬和难以置信、陷入沉思的哈利，满身是血地往回走

3d2606a6a70f.en: Magi and Eori stumble on a nari gel stand
3d2606a6a70f.t: 玛姬和埃奥丽偶然发现了一个纳里凝胶摊位

3d51961ed72b.en: Chapter 4 - Ryo, Katsuki in a wagon.
3d51961ed72b.t: 第 4 章 - 亮、胜希在马车上。

3f233711976c.en: Ryo: "Excuse us, Princess Eori—" "WHAT? Who the fuck are you?" Ryo clears his throat. "Ryo Flatland Long-Blue, and this is my lovely companion Katsuki, of—" Eori looks pretty impatient. "—okay, then."
3f233711976c.t: 亮：“打扰一下，埃奥丽公主——”“干嘛？你他妈是谁？”亮清了清嗓子。“亮·弗拉特兰·朗布卢，这位是我可爱的伴侣胜希，来自——”埃奥丽看起来相当不耐烦。“——好吧，就这样。”

3f2338155ecb.en: Katsuki cries: she wants to help Harry. Ryo explains that she and her sister had a falling-out with him, and she wants to rebuild bridges, and recaps what happened. Coema: "Arukia filled in some of the other details too."
3f2338155ecb.t: 胜希哭了：她想帮助哈利。亮解释说她和她的姐妹和他闹翻了，她想重建关系，并简述了发生的事。科埃玛：“阿露琪娅也补充了一些其他细节。”

401a9f8b4610.en: The Cruro tosses it, but a bit away from her. Arukia peeks out from her shield to grab it, immediately sees a moonlit flash in the distance, and pulls her head back: an arrow screams by, cutting her hair and scratching her skin. The scratch burns, splits open and bleeds more; warm blood runs down her face and drips from her chin.
401a9f8b4610.t: 克鲁罗把刀扔了过来，但离她有点远。阿露琪娅从她的盾牌后面探出头去拿刀，立刻看到远处月光下一闪，便把头缩了回来：一支箭呼啸而过，削断了她的头发，划伤了她的皮肤。划伤处火辣辣的，裂开来，流出更多的血；温热的血顺着她的脸流下来，从下巴滴落。

405e5a6570df.en: Eori and Morika fight. She gets the upper hand by using the environment against {WIP-morikaDecoy}, then kills him. She ties his hands and feet and uses a Nari Refresher on the body, which turns back into {WIP-morikaDecoy}. Eori, in a fury, stomps on its brain, splattering it across the floor.
405e5a6570df.t: 埃奥丽和莫里卡打了起来。她利用周围的环境对付 {WIP-morikaDecoy}，占了上风，然后杀了他。她绑住他的手脚，对尸体用了纳里里弗雷舍，尸体变回了 {WIP-morikaDecoy}。埃奥丽怒不可遏，一脚踩在它的脑袋上，脑浆溅了一地。

40acb249b763.t: 第 3 章 - 酝酿中的阴谋

40f73d8e5e03.en: Magi, Eori (in a fake body), Ryo and a few Cruros on the road
40f73d8e5e03.t: 玛姬、埃奥丽（用着假身体）、亮和几个克鲁罗在路上

40fdb4bee7fd.en: Magi, in soaked clothes and cold, waits at the table while Harry, in his #13 clothes (the numbers tie in to the illustrations), cooks
40fdb4bee7fd.t: 玛姬穿着湿透的衣服，冻得发冷，在桌边等着，而穿着 #13 衣服（编号和插图对应）的哈利在做饭

426cabce76af.t: 第 3 章 - 玛姬·布拉德·布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩

426f765d1d52.en: Harry, on the ground, takes off running with all the might he has, but as he runs, he sees Eori quickly making up ground. He tries to go down the stairs, trips and falls on his hands. He tries to stumble down the rest of the way, then feels a tackle pin him against the wall.
426f765d1d52.t: 地上的哈利用尽全身力气拔腿就跑，但他边跑边看到埃奥丽飞快地追了上来。他想下楼梯，却绊了一下，手撑在地上摔倒了。他想跌跌撞撞地走完剩下的台阶，然后感到一记飞扑把他按在了墙上。

42cf859b566b.en: Eori looks ticked off and doesn't reply. Magi, on her other side, looks at her too. Eori: "Harry is mine, and he knows it." Ryo and Magi look at her. "He—he even said he loved me." Ryo: "He did? Wow." Magi, suspicious: "If he loved you, then why was he faking his name?" Eori gets angry. "That's between me and Harry! Arukia was the one who split us up!"
42cf859b566b.t: 埃奥丽看起来很恼火，没有回答。在她另一边的玛姬也看着她。埃奥丽：“哈利是我的，他自己也知道。”亮和玛姬看着她。“他——他甚至说过他爱我。”亮：“他说过？哇。”玛姬怀疑地说：“如果他爱你，那他为什么要用假名？”埃奥丽生气了。“那是我和哈利之间的事！是阿露琪娅拆散了我们！”

437d12777000.en: Eori, leaving the scene, hears Morika's steps quickly catching up. She ignores him and keeps walking, anywhere but back to this fake Harry. Morika: "I'll have to report to Neferteri that you lost your—" Eori, in anguish: "Fuck it! Do it! I fucking dare you!" Morika doesn't rise to her anger. Calmly: "Princess Eori, please return to the Nari School with me." Eori, on the fence: "I'll go back by myself. Leave me the fuck alone." "I'm bound by contract not to leave you alone."
437d12777000.t: 离开现场的埃奥丽听到莫里卡的脚步声迅速追了上来。她不理他，继续走着，去哪里都行，只要不回到这个假哈利那里。莫里卡：“我得向奈菲尔特丽报告您丢了您的——”埃奥丽痛苦地说：“去他妈的！去报告啊！我他妈谅你也不敢！”莫里卡没有被她的愤怒激怒。他平静地说：“埃奥丽公主，请和我一起回纳里学校。”埃奥丽犹豫着：“我自己回去。他妈的别烦我。”“我受契约约束，不能离开您。”

445c3b714515.en: Eori gets a letter from Neferteri telling her to support Maiara's championship
445c3b714515.t: 埃奥丽收到奈菲尔特丽的一封信，叫她去支持迈阿拉的锦标赛

452e160dc0b1.en: Eori: "It's him! It's Morika! But why would mom let him wear his full armor while doing her bidding out in the city?" Coema: "Because she's baiting us too. She wants us to follow him." Morika delivers the final blow.
452e160dc0b1.t: 埃奥丽：“是他！是莫里卡！可妈妈为什么会让他穿着全套盔甲在城里替她办事？”科埃玛：“因为她也在给我们下饵。她想让我们跟着他。”莫里卡打出了最后一击。

45586fbece6e.en: Magi takes another bite. She watches Desmond as she eats, and something about him seems familiar, and it isn't the Breadplate she's always eating because it's free.
45586fbece6e.t: 玛姬又咬了一口。她一边吃一边看着德斯蒙德，觉得他有什么地方很眼熟，而那不是她因为免费而一直在吃的面包盘。

45679189e515.en: A second messenger: "My Queen, you've also been summoned to an emergency meeting." Neferteri snaps out of her thoughts. "For what reason?" "Eori's disappearance." "Who called the meeting?" "The King's maid, my Queen." Neferteri: Someone at the Forway school must have leaked it to her—or are they acting according to a plan? The messenger notices Neferteri has gone pale. "My Queen?" Neferteri snaps out of her thoughts… (the notes end here).
45679189e515.t: 第二个信使：“我的王后，您还被召去参加一个紧急会议。”奈菲尔特丽从思绪中回过神来。“为了什么事？”“埃奥丽的失踪。”“谁召集的会议？”“国王女仆，我的王后。”奈菲尔特丽：一定是福威学校的什么人向她泄露了消息——还是说他们在按计划行事？信使注意到奈菲尔特丽脸色发白。“我的王后？”奈菲尔特丽从思绪中回过神来……（笔记到此为止）。

45949e18516a.t: 第 2 章 - 不被鼓励的研究

476598c7b5a1.en: She hesitates to sign, but does. She takes Harry's badge and puts it away. She feels the pressure of how badly losing it (3 Sapphires) would screw her over: she'd likely spend the rest of her life working for Forway for free.
476598c7b5a1.t: 她犹豫着要不要签，但还是签了。她拿过哈利的身份牌收好。她感到了压力，要是弄丢了它（3 颗萨菲尔），她会被坑得有多惨：她很可能下半辈子都要免费给福威干活。

47d9f1b7258c.en: Emelia and the Madam, Laura, discuss the appearance of Harry's nari gels. Laura says it's because the Red Winga stayed hidden long enough that the Sanbi Royals decided to act more aggressively, and that it's time for the Red Winga to act more aggressively too, since the current conservative strategy hasn't paid off.
47d9f1b7258c.t: 艾米莉娅和夫人劳拉讨论哈利纳里凝胶的出现。劳拉说，这是因为雷德温加隐藏得太久，桑比王室决定采取更激进的行动，现在雷德温加也该更激进了，因为目前保守的策略没有带来回报。

4901f585d042.en: Magi pulls out a Nari Refresher. "Not that! I need to keep my current appearance." Keeping her distance, Magi tosses her a nari stone and a ring. "Do it yourself." Eori does. "All right, if you don't trust me, then trust this." She tosses a bag of balls at Magi's feet.
4901f585d042.t: 玛姬拿出一份纳里里弗雷舍。“不要那个！我需要保持现在的外貌。”玛姬保持着距离，扔给她一颗纳里石和一枚戒指。“你自己来。”埃奥丽照做了。“好吧，如果你不相信我，那就相信这个。”她把一袋球扔到玛姬脚边。

49816c3c8815.en: She heads for Yosuke's restaurant, but her steps grow weaker. What is he running from? Why wouldn't he change himself more? She realizes he was eating with her. Does he work for food and a place to live?
49816c3c8815.t: 她朝洋介的餐馆走去，但脚步越来越无力。他在逃避什么？他为什么不把自己改变得更多一些？她意识到他刚才在和她一起吃饭。他是在为了吃住而工作吗？

4ab9d90e10a9.en: A server comes over. "Whatcha want?" Ryo: "Can we have some juice instead?" The server lists the juices. Ryo looks at Katsuki, eating with a sad face as she eyes the beer jug. "Anything tickle your fancy?" "One—beer." "No deal." She picks a juice. Ryo starts drinking the beer; Katsuki gives him puppy eyes. He puts it aside. "Okay. I'll stop drinking it with you." Katsuki brightens with a smile.
4ab9d90e10a9.t: 一个服务员走过来。“要点啥？”亮：“我们能换成果汁吗？”服务员报出了果汁的种类。亮看向胜希，她一脸难过地吃着，眼睛盯着啤酒壶。“有什么想喝的吗？”“一——啤酒。”“没门。”她选了一种果汁。亮开始喝啤酒；胜希冲他眨着可怜巴巴的眼睛。他把啤酒放到一边。“好吧。我不当着你的面喝了。”胜希眉开眼笑。

4b4ac170343d.en: Harry sits down, his back aching from all the work. Someone offers him the last bit of Nari Refresher; Harry says he's good. He just needs a beer and some rest instead. Rimir pours him one. "You suck at cooking, but at least you can do the grunt work, unlike a certain someone." Mimi: "I'm helpful too!" They banter.
4b4ac170343d.t: 哈利坐了下来，干了这么多活，背都酸了。有人把最后一点纳里里弗雷舍递给他；哈利说他没事。他只需要一杯啤酒和一些休息。里米尔给他倒了一杯。“你做饭很烂，但至少你能干粗活，不像某个人。”咪咪：“我也很有用！”他们斗起嘴来。

4ba4a9a0e66a.en: Magi, frustrated: "Okay, I'm sorry. I didn't want to shoot you, but you left me no choice when you took off running. I was within my rights, you know?" Harry remembers seeing her earlier that day. "So you were following me too?" "Yeah, but you're not Harry."
4ba4a9a0e66a.t: 玛姬沮丧地说：“好吧，对不起。我不想射你，但你拔腿就跑，我别无选择。我是有权这么做的，你知道吗？”哈利想起那天早些时候见过她。“所以你也一直在跟踪我？”“是啊，但你不是哈利。”

4bd72a2b5b1f.en: The sweet old clerk, now voiding the contract: "That's terrible. I hope he's proud of you, fighting to become a Sapphire adventurer too. Sign here." Magi signs. "Anything else, Adventurer Magi?" Magi looks at her, reminded of her late grandma on her father's side, who was just as sweet. "Do you have any easy-money quests?" The clerk offers some, and Magi accepts a few more boring ones.
4bd72a2b5b1f.t: 这位和蔼的老文员现在正在作废契约：“那太可怕了。我希望他为你感到骄傲，你也在奋斗，要成为萨菲尔级冒险者。在这里签名。”玛姬签了名。“还有别的事吗，冒险者玛姬？”玛姬看着她，想起了她已故的祖母，父亲那边的，也一样和蔼。“您有什么好赚钱的任务吗？”文员给了她一些，玛姬又接了几个无聊的任务。

4d8fd3df06a9.en: Yosuke wakes the gang at the crack of dawn
4d8fd3df06a9.t: 天刚亮，洋介就叫醒了伙伴们

4ec35a98be0b.en: Magi out on a boring quest
4ec35a98be0b.t: 玛姬在做一个无聊的任务

4f16214ac4ff.en: Ryo: "Really?" Then this is a classic case of sending a message, but to whom? The Red Winga? Could they be sending a message to my girls? This could be the chance to cut ties with the Red Winga for good. He contracts {WIP-ryoDistributor} to spread the new whorehouse flyers to all the villages for him. He was going to find someone in Forway, but {WIP-ryoDistributor} has proved good in the past.
4f16214ac4ff.t: 亮：“真的？”那这就是一个典型的传递信息的手法，但是传给谁？雷德温加？他们会不会是在给我的姑娘们传递信息？这可能是和雷德温加彻底断绝关系的机会。他和 {WIP-ryoDistributor} 签了契约，让他帮忙把新妓院的传单发到所有村子里。他本来打算在福威找人，但 {WIP-ryoDistributor} 过去的表现证明他很靠谱。

51046aeb66a1.en: Harry and the gang in a wagon; Magi follows them in the background
51046aeb66a1.t: 哈利和伙伴们坐在一辆马车上；玛姬在背景里跟着他们

5276921cd5d8.en: The Bruntos climbs onto the bed; she puts it back on the floor. It cries, and the people around her get pissed, so she puts it on the bed to shut it up.
5276921cd5d8.t: 布伦托斯爬上了床；她把它放回地上。它哭了，她周围的人都被吵烦了，于是她把它放到床上让它闭嘴。

52a23d3e7606.en: Coema: "Ryo, it's not too late to take me up on my offer." (What the offer is stays between Ryo and Coema.) Ryo laughs, pulls Katsuki close and rubs her belly. "Tempting, yes, but I'll have to pass." Coema watches his hand. "I see. Well, I assume you came to see me for something other than my stories?" Ryo looks at Katsuki. "Go on."
52a23d3e7606.t: 科埃玛：“亮，现在接受我的提议还不算太晚。”（那个提议是什么，只有亮和科埃玛知道。）亮笑了，把胜希拉近，揉着她的肚子。“很诱人，没错，但我只好拒绝了。”科埃玛看着他的手。“我明白了。好吧，我想你来找我不是为了听我讲故事吧？”亮看向胜希。“说吧。”

54d4e4bb6f81.en: She sets up an ambush, and as the person walks into it, Magi releases an arrow at a seemingly random citizen. A girl screams: "You fucking bitch! I was trying to talk to you!" She pulls out her badge, which lights up; Magi can clearly see "Eori Sanbi Royal".
54d4e4bb6f81.t: 她设下埋伏，当那个人走进埋伏圈时，玛姬朝一个看起来像普通市民的人射出了一箭。一个女孩尖叫道：“你这个操蛋的贱人！我是想跟你说话！”她掏出身份牌，身份牌亮了起来；玛姬清楚地看到了“埃奥丽·桑比·罗亚尔”。

55105044973d.en: Dalila gasps. "Hanako! Look!" There are balls and a note on the other beds too. Dalila reads it out loud: "I'm sorry. I'll tell you the truth when I come back from the atelier." Magi hands her paper over. "He wrote that to me as well." Dalila looks happy, counting the money she got.
55105044973d.t: 达莉拉倒吸一口气。“花子！你看！”其他床上也有球和纸条。达莉拉大声念出来：“对不起。等我从裁缝铺回来，我会告诉你们真相。”玛姬把她的纸条递了过去。“他也给我写了这个。”达莉拉看起来很开心，数着她拿到的钱。

58616ec31a8a.en: The room goes quiet. Coema looks at Arukia. "Arukia, are you ready for your punishment?" Arukia hesitates, then stands, leaving her baby on the seat, aching for her embrace. Coema gets close as if to slap her, but instead softly pats her cheeks with both hands. "The Red Winga, and maybe Neferteri too, won't miss the chance to capture you this time. If you agree to be bait, I promise you a vote from Eiri and Itagiba to exonerate your past actions when the time comes."
58616ec31a8a.t: 房间里安静了下来。科埃玛看着阿露琪娅。“阿露琪娅，你准备好接受惩罚了吗？”阿露琪娅犹豫了一下，然后站了起来，把宝宝留在座位上，宝宝渴望着她的怀抱。科埃玛走近，好像要扇她，却用双手轻轻拍了拍她的脸颊。“雷德温加，也许还有奈菲尔特丽，这次不会错过抓住你的机会。如果你同意当诱饵，我保证到时候艾莉和伊塔吉巴会投票为你过去的行为开脱。”

58ac1d6d3fe2.t: 当埃奥丽再次见到哈利时

59bba848f7bf.en: Eori: "What did you do to my Harry?" Katsuki fumbles. "One. Took. Two. Care." "What's she saying?" Ryo: "She took great care of Harry after Arukia took him away, and even helped him escape, but they ditched him at the last second." "Where?" "South of Forway. She and her sister were imprisoned at a Black Magina camp. Luckily, I found her sister, who escaped, dying on the roadside." Eori: "So what are you all doing, then?" Ryo: "Using Arukia as bait, and then acting on what she finds?" Coema smiles. "Indeed! We likely have a few more time chunks to share what we know about him!"
59bba848f7bf.t: 埃奥丽：“你对我的哈利做了什么？”胜希慌乱地说：“一。照顾。二。很好。”“她在说什么？”亮：“阿露琪娅把哈利带走之后，她把哈利照顾得很好，甚至帮他逃跑，但她们在最后一秒丢下了他。”“在哪儿？”“福威南边。她和她的姐妹被关在一个布莱克玛吉纳营地里。幸运的是，我找到了她逃出来的姐妹，她当时快死在路边了。”埃奥丽：“那你们现在打算干什么？”亮：“用阿露琪娅当诱饵，然后根据她发现的东西行动？”科埃玛笑了。“没错！我们大概还有几个泰姆汉克可以分享我们所知道的关于他的事！”

59c2bf79697d.en: Guards show up. "The fuck happened here?" Magi pulls out both badges and explains it all; Yosuke pulls out his and confirms it. The guards see that Harry's outfit matches Yosuke's. "All right. Clean this mess up, or we'll come after you."
59c2bf79697d.t: 卫兵们出现了。“这他妈是怎么回事？”玛姬拿出两块身份牌，解释了一切；洋介也拿出他的身份牌证实了。卫兵们看到哈利的衣服和洋介的一样。“好了。把这堆烂摊子收拾干净，否则我们会找你们算账。”

59dbb6b10282.en: Magi and Eori at the restaurant near closing time; Hanako and Mimi at the door tell Magi to get fucked
59dbb6b10282.t: 快打烊时玛姬和埃奥丽在餐馆里；门口的花子和咪咪叫玛姬滚蛋

5a25d4695efd.en: "Sorry, adventurer, but we're about to close." A white-haired stranger smiles at her. She holds her cold hands against her chest. "Do you have any Breadplates?" The white-haired guy's smile disappears. He looks inside at some patrons finishing their meals. "We might have some soon. We've got plenty of empty tables too, so come in and warm up."
5a25d4695efd.t: “抱歉，冒险者，我们快打烊了。”一个白发的陌生人对她微笑。她把冰冷的双手贴在胸前。“你们有面包盘吗？”白发男人的笑容消失了。他看向里面一些正在吃完饭的顾客。“我们可能很快就会有一些。我们还有很多空桌子，进来暖和暖和吧。”

5b7d31fad17f.en: A loud bonk on the table, followed by rattling plates and silverware. Harry turns to see Magi passed out, in what looks like a pretty uncomfortable position. "You okay?" No response. Without wasting time, he finishes cooking, plates the meal and goes to check on the pink adventurer. He touches her limp shoulders and notices how cold she is; her cheeks are bluish too. Well, I told her she could borrow Hanako's clothes while hers dried.
5b7d31fad17f.t: 桌上传来一声响亮的砰，接着是盘子和餐具的哗啦声。哈利转过身，看到玛姬昏了过去，姿势看起来很不舒服。“你还好吗？”没有回应。他毫不耽搁地做完饭，把菜装盘，去看看粉衣冒险者怎么样了。他碰了碰她软绵绵的肩膀，发现她冷得厉害；她的脸颊也发青。嗯，我跟她说过在她的衣服晾干前可以借花子的衣服穿。

5e433592045a.t: 第 13 卷 - 命运之日

5ec80ff347da.en: Arukia gets ready for bed, holding the baby Bruntos
5ec80ff347da.t: 阿露琪娅抱着布伦托斯宝宝准备睡觉

5fc3a1494dc0.en: Laura: "Send all agents to Sanbi, and find all the hidden research, by any means necessary." Emelia: "Yes, Madam. I'll relay the message to the other agents."
5fc3a1494dc0.t: 劳拉：“把所有特工都派到桑比去，不惜一切手段找出所有隐藏的研究。”艾米莉娅：“是，夫人。我会把消息转达给其他特工。”

60e5d419c756.en: Arukia: "What about my baby?" "Sora will take care of him, right, Sora?" Sora: "But! But! I've never taken care of a Bruntos before." "Arukia, hand him to her." She does. The baby rests his head against Sora's breasts, feels uncomfortable, pats around trying to find where they went, gets angry and starts crying. Sora looks at Arukia's breasts, then at hers, and her mood sinks. Coema: "Just add some padding for now, and it'll be fine. Nothing to be ashamed of."
60e5d419c756.t: 阿露琪娅：“那我的宝宝呢？”“索拉会照顾他的，对吧，索拉？”索拉：“可是！可是！我从来没照顾过布伦托斯。”“阿露琪娅，把他交给她。”她照做了。宝宝把头靠在索拉的胸前，觉得不舒服，四处拍着想找到它们去哪儿了，生起气来，开始哭。索拉看看阿露琪娅的胸，又看看自己的，心情一落千丈。科埃玛：“先垫点东西，就没事了。没什么好羞愧的。”

61b5df9d1da2.en: Eori, disguised as a commoner, bleeding from an arrow; Magi realizes she just shot a princess of Sanbi
61b5df9d1da2.t: 伪装成平民的埃奥丽中了一箭在流血；玛姬意识到她刚刚射了一位桑比公主

62a3d3f03d7a.en: The girl with her (Eori): "She has a crush on Har—a crush on Desmond. Now get over it, and just fucking tell us what you know." Magi, blushing, says she doesn't. Hanako: "Har?" Eori: "None of your business."
62a3d3f03d7a.t: 和她一起的女孩（埃奥丽）：“她暗恋哈——暗恋德斯蒙德。现在别计较了，他妈的告诉我们你们知道什么。”玛姬红着脸说她没有。花子：“哈？”埃奥丽：“不关你的事。”

62e7023dc848.t: 第 4 章 - 这是个陷阱！

648969b246ba.en: Ryo in front of the finished place, with Katsumi, Katsuki and two adventurers
648969b246ba.t: 亮站在完工的地方前面，旁边是胜美、胜希和两个冒险者

6545ebbafca5.en: Magi is sleepy, her arms are sore and her body is cranky, but her mind is strong-willed. She keeps following the cart as it heads to a solitary home in a small village. The cart stops, and Magi lands on a branch of a nearby tree as the man looks around, drawing his weapon.
6545ebbafca5.t: 玛姬很困，手臂酸痛，身体也不舒服，但她的意志很坚强。她一直跟着那辆车，它驶向一个小村子里一座孤零零的房子。车停了下来，玛姬落在附近一棵树的树枝上，那人拔出武器环顾四周。

656af6cf2929.en: Harry spills something and cleans it up as he answers. "I got the name Desmond from someone I knew. Rebula is where I woke up after—" He seems to be mincing his words. "After what?" "Hmmm—never mind. I don't remember much." Magi looks suspicious. "Or you don't want to say?" "Well, I really don't remember some stuff, but other stuff I do. Saying it out loud sounds weird, since I'm not even Harry. I mean, I don't want to make things worse for people now—"
656af6cf2929.t: 哈利洒了点东西，一边清理一边回答。“德斯蒙德这个名字是从我认识的一个人那里来的。雷布拉是我醒来的地方，在——”他似乎在斟酌用词。“在什么之后？”“嗯——没什么。我记不太清了。”玛姬看起来很怀疑。“还是你不想说？”“嗯，有些事我确实不记得了，但有些事我记得。说出来听起来很奇怪，因为我甚至都不是哈利。我是说，我不想让现在的人们处境变得更糟——”

6704cd0cc191.en: Arukia works the farmland under the hot sun
6704cd0cc191.t: 阿露琪娅在烈日下耕田

6a93b1fceab0.en: Emelia: "So Eiri is pulling the strings now? That's odd. Either way, keep tabs, day and night, on every single person Arukia knows. She knows too much!" Bandits: "Do we—"
6a93b1fceab0.t: 艾米莉娅：“所以现在是艾莉在操纵？真奇怪。不管怎样，日夜盯着阿露琪娅认识的每一个人。她知道得太多了！”强盗们：“我们要不要——”

6f524cb94e61.en: Eori decides Coema is working with Neferteri too, and gets pissed: she'll use the money Coema gave her to go back to Sanbi and whoop her ass. "We're going to Sanbi." Magi: "What?" "I'm gonna wipe the smirk off Coema's face." "Coema?" "The previous Sanbi King's maid. Let's go."
6f524cb94e61.t: 埃奥丽认定科埃玛也在和奈菲尔特丽合作，气坏了：她要用科埃玛给她的钱回桑比去，把她揍一顿。“我们去桑比。”玛姬：“什么？”“我要把科埃玛脸上的得意笑容打掉。”“科埃玛？”“上一任桑比国王的女仆。走吧。”

7055ccf675ec.en: Same scene, but a guy goes table to table selling nari gel
7055ccf675ec.t: 同一个场景，不过有个人在一桌一桌地兜售纳里凝胶

70633e6ad5e3.en: Magi tries to hold back her emotions, but sadness peeks through. "You know him?" "But of course, my dear. I was at the Blood branch of the Embassy for twenty-some years before I was promoted to manage this branch. Say, it's been a while since I heard about him. Did he retire?" "He—he disappeared."
70633e6ad5e3.t: 玛姬试图忍住自己的情绪，但悲伤还是流露了出来。“您认识他？”“当然了，亲爱的。我在大使馆的布拉德分馆待了二十多年，才被提拔来管理这个分馆。说起来，我好久没听到他的消息了。他退休了吗？”“他——他失踪了。”

707ee081e520.en: Yosuke pulls a key from his robe and hands it to Magi. "That's all on you." "What do you want me to do, then?" "It's obvious. Take Desmond back to the restaurant and tell him to wait for me." Magi takes the key. Yosuke starts to leave. "Don't you dare steal anything, or my acquaintances will have a talk with you."
707ee081e520.t: 洋介从袍子里掏出一把钥匙递给玛姬。“这全是你的事了。”“那你要我做什么？”“这还用说。把德斯蒙德带回餐馆，叫他等我。”玛姬接过钥匙。洋介转身要走。“你敢偷任何东西，我的熟人们就会找你谈谈。”

70f61a4e8f81.en: He imagines what life could have been if he hadn't lied. He called himself Desmond out of fear, and look where it got him. He tries to get out again, but it doesn't work. He screams for help, says he's Harry, but nothing happens. Harry lowers his head. I fucked this up.
70f61a4e8f81.t: 他想象着如果他没有撒谎，生活会是什么样子。他出于恐惧自称德斯蒙德，看看这让他落得什么下场。他又试着逃出去，但没有用。他大声呼救，说他是哈利，但什么也没发生。哈利低下了头。我把一切都搞砸了。

71f41a49392a.en: Eori lets him go. Harry seizes the opportunity and takes off running downstairs. Eori and Magi exchange a look, and both take off after him. Magi leaps from the stairs to gain height, and with a quick fling of her bow, an arrow screams toward Harry and lands in his left lung.
71f41a49392a.t: 埃奥丽放开了他。哈利抓住机会，拔腿往楼下跑。埃奥丽和玛姬对视一眼，两人都追了上去。玛姬从楼梯上一跃而起以获得高度，弓一甩，一支箭呼啸着射向哈利，正中他的左肺。

7280c7073b31.en: He sets the empty glass down. A loud burp echoes around, and he taps his chest. "See, my friends? Totally safe! This round is on the house." He lowers his voice. "Tell Coema that Ryo is back in town, and he has info on the bait." He takes Katsuki's hand and leads her back to their seats. "Sorry, babe, but I had to prove a point. I had no choice." Katsuki sighs. "One—tell. Two—next." "Will do, baby. Now let's hang out here until a Cruro takes us to her."
7280c7073b31.t: 他放下空杯子。一声响亮的嗝在周围回荡，他拍了拍胸口。“看到了吗，朋友们？完全安全！这一轮我请。”他压低声音。“告诉科埃玛，亮回城里了，他有关于诱饵的情报。”他拉着胜希的手，带她回到座位上。“对不起，宝贝，但我得证明一点。我别无选择。”胜希叹了口气。“一——说。二——下次。”“遵命，宝贝。现在我们在这里待着，等一个克鲁罗带我们去见她。”

7356963f789e.en: Yosuke and the gang finish preparing for tomorrow: Harry skewers food on wooden sticks and hands them to Mimi, who dips them in liquid and passes them to Hanako for the cooler
7356963f789e.t: 洋介和伙伴们为明天做最后的准备：哈利把食物串在木签上递给咪咪，咪咪把它们蘸上汁水，再递给花子放进冷藏箱

7359c0febfce.en: Meanwhile, Magi glances at Harry, lost in thought. He was afraid of Eori. Nari Refresher barely changed his appearance, and he clearly fled from Eori. There's clearly something going on here. She touches the pocket where the badge is hidden. What if this badge is fake? She pictures being hanged for saying that out loud.
7359c0febfce.t: 与此同时，玛姬瞥了一眼陷入沉思的哈利。他害怕埃奥丽。纳里里弗雷舍几乎没有改变他的外貌，而且他明显是在逃离埃奥丽。这里面明显有什么问题。她摸了摸藏着身份牌的口袋。要是这块身份牌是假的呢？她想象着自己因为大声说出这句话而被绞死。

736be7128b67.en: Ryo, Magi, Eori and Coema on nari gel (only Magi is really ready to fly), with a few more Cruros, watch from high above as Morika and Arukia fight
736be7128b67.t: 用了纳里凝胶的亮、玛姬、埃奥丽和科埃玛（只有玛姬真正准备好飞行），还有几个克鲁罗，从高处看着莫里卡和阿露琪娅战斗

74bb3faf1760.en: Harry looks back down the road he's walked so many times carrying wares for the restaurant. Who the fuck am I, then? I clearly stole the name Desmond from that Wozen bandit girl. I clearly remember waking up in Sanbi, and everything in between—except nothing from after I ate the Bagarisa nari gel until I woke up in Rebula—if I'm not Harry, then who am I?
74bb3faf1760.t: 哈利回头看着那条他为餐馆搬货走过无数次的路。那我他妈到底是谁？我明明是从那个沃增强盗女孩那里偷来德斯蒙德这个名字的。我明明清楚地记得在桑比醒来，以及那之间的一切——除了我吃下巴加里萨纳里凝胶之后、直到在雷布拉醒来之间的事——如果我不是哈利，那我是谁？

74be635ccc35.en: Her meat shield suddenly wakes up, turns around and shoves her to the ground; startled, she lets go of the knife. He squeezes the life out of her, the knife just out of reach. She struggles. He says Emelia is gonna fuck her up the ass: the Madam is really pissed off, and will hunt down and kill both her and Harry.
74be635ccc35.t: 她的肉盾突然醒了过来，转过身把她推倒在地；她吓了一跳，松开了刀。他死死掐住她，刀就在够不着的地方。她挣扎着。他说艾米莉娅会把她的屁眼操烂：夫人真的气坏了，会追杀她和哈利，把他们俩都干掉。

74d9af47b597.en: Neferteri, Morika, Arukia, and a chained Harry, in the hideout
74d9af47b597.t: 奈菲尔特丽、莫里卡、阿露琪娅，以及被锁着的哈利，在藏身处

74e0d159395a.en: Mimi and the gang ignore her, and she feels bad about what she said. She keeps walking until she notices someone following her. She picks up her pace, and so does the other person.
74e0d159395a.t: 咪咪和伙伴们不理她，她为自己说过的话感到难过。她继续走着，直到注意到有人在跟踪她。她加快了脚步，那个人也加快了。

75650ae1b56f.en: Coema looks at the Harry nari gel. "So that's Harry?" Her guild was contacted by a merchant from Sanbi who had a batch of nari gel, and paid top dollar to have it shipped across all the kingdoms. Eiri: "Isn't that suspicious?" "A bit, but it's not the first time. People who are trying to book it usually do that." Eiri and Sora: "So Harry is alive, and trying to get out of his contract?" "Exactly."
75650ae1b56f.t: 科埃玛看着哈利纳里凝胶。“这就是哈利？”她的公会被一个来自桑比的商人联系过，那人有一批纳里凝胶，出了高价要把它运往所有王国。艾莉：“这不可疑吗？”“有点，但这不是第一次了。想跑路的人通常都会这么做。”艾莉和索拉：“所以哈利还活着，想摆脱他的契约？”“正是。”

75955fca08f4.t: 第 2 章 - 前桑比女仆。

75d42a960002.en: Magi doesn't respond; she seems dissatisfied too, and starts to think it over. Did she just stumble into a conspiracy? What should she do? Could it be the same one that made her father disappear? Hanako: "Fine! We'll find him on our own!"
75d42a960002.t: 玛姬没有回应；她似乎也不满意，开始仔细思考。她是不是刚刚撞上了一个阴谋？她该怎么办？会不会是让她父亲失踪的同一个阴谋？花子：“好！我们自己去找他！”

762139d16d6f.t: 第 2 章 - 弗拉特兰的最新生意

76332a1cfd28.en: Magi, looking wiped out, back at the meeting spot with Eori (in a fake body), Coema, Ryo, Katsuki and a few Cruros
76332a1cfd28.t: 看起来筋疲力尽的玛姬回到集合点，和埃奥丽（用着假身体）、科埃玛、亮、胜希以及几个克鲁罗在一起

775a8f981ba1.en: Ryo, Magi, Eori (jacked) and Coema sit on top of a building as four more carts, with five Morikas, leave it
775a8f981ba1.t: 亮、玛姬、埃奥丽（肌肉暴涨）和科埃玛坐在一栋建筑的顶上，看着又有四辆车、五个莫里卡离开那里

776eca649cb8.en: Arukia: "You only care about yourself! If you hadn't done what you did to Harry, I wouldn't have had to do the things I did!" "So you were forced by an outsider. Who?" Arukia looks at her and doesn't answer.
776eca649cb8.t: 阿露琪娅：“你只在乎你自己！如果你没有对哈利做那些事，我就不用做我做过的那些事！”“所以你是被一个外人逼的。是谁？”阿露琪娅看着她，没有回答。

7badea78d8f3.en: Magi, bloodied, is confused by Harry's appearance
7badea78d8f3.t: 满身是血的玛姬对哈利的外貌感到困惑

7d1808935457.en: They banter, and Harry is left with menial tasks. Hanako notices Harry keeping an eye on everything around him. "Are you expecting someone or what?" "Of course not." Yosuke: "I'm watching you!" Dalila: "I'm taste-testing the base!" Yosuke flips something perfectly, and Rimir pours something over it in unison.
7d1808935457.t: 他们斗着嘴，哈利只能做些杂活。花子注意到哈利一直在留意周围的一切。“你在等什么人还是怎么的？”“当然没有。”洋介：“我盯着你呢！”达莉拉：“我在试吃汤底！”洋介完美地翻了一下什么东西，里米尔同时往上面浇了些东西。

7db90b152aa4.t: 第 1 章 - 意想不到的盟友

7eb8adec121c.t: 第 2 章 - 分崩离析

7ef2ede83ce8.en: Messenger: "My Queen, someone invaded the safehouse (Eori's old hideout), on the upper floor. The invader fought with {WIP-morikaDecoy} and killed him, then left without taking anything." Neferteri: "As I expected." Eori wouldn't be capable of doing all this alone.
7ef2ede83ce8.t: 信使：“我的王后，有人闯进了安全屋（埃奥丽以前的藏身处）的楼上。入侵者和 {WIP-morikaDecoy} 打了起来，杀了他，然后什么也没拿就走了。”奈菲尔特丽：“正如我所料。”埃奥丽一个人是做不到这一切的。

7fa9619fd995.en: Neferteri approaches Arukia. "Your disappearance wasn't a coincidence. If you simply cooperate with me, I'm willing to put this behind us." Arukia spits on the ground. "I served you for months! I know what you're capable of!" "Enlighten me." "You're gonna torch me once you have what you need, so fuck off!" Neferteri smiles slightly.
7fa9619fd995.t: 奈菲尔特丽走近阿露琪娅。“你的失踪不是巧合。如果你乖乖配合我，我愿意既往不咎。”阿露琪娅往地上吐了口唾沫。“我服侍了你好几个月！我知道你能干出什么事！”“说来听听。”“等你得到你需要的东西，你就会把我烧了，所以滚吧！”奈菲尔特丽微微一笑。

8033abba8bcb.en: She opens a bag of balls: an Aquamarine, plus change. She opens another letter from Coema: "Good Princess! Now wreak havoc! Have fun! Light it up! Make Neferteri red with anger! Make sure to fully change your appearance, and don't use mail, or anything that needs your badge, or they'll find you quickly. The withdrawal I preauthorized for you should last a few weeks if you invest it wisely. Break free! Do what you want!"
8033abba8bcb.t: 她打开一袋球：一颗阿夸马林，外加一些零钱。她又打开科埃玛的一封信：“好公主！现在去大闹一场吧！玩得开心！点燃一切！让奈菲尔特丽气得满脸通红！一定要彻底改变你的外貌，别用邮件，也别用任何需要你身份牌的东西，否则他们很快就会找到你。我为你预先授权的取款，如果你花得聪明，应该够撑几周。挣脱束缚！做你想做的！”

80c1e2ccc70b.en: Eiri and Sora at a stand; Harry's face (just as he was, fat and all) is one of the items for sale
80c1e2ccc70b.t: 艾莉和索拉在一个摊位前；哈利的脸（就是他原来的样子，胖乎乎的）是出售的商品之一

8256169a79fd.en: It all goes to shit, and ends with Arukia trying to fight Morika, and getting her head bashed in instead.
8256169a79fd.t: 一切都搞砸了，最后阿露琪娅试图和莫里卡战斗，反而被打烂了头。

829d43150ef5.en: Bandit: "—kill them all on contact?" Emelia: "Do what's necessary. Our Madam has decided to make an example of her." (The Madam is Laura.) "Then we'll make a real example of her." "Don't bother me with the details. Now get out! You two are an eyesore."
829d43150ef5.t: 强盗：“——一碰到就把他们全杀了？”艾米莉娅：“做必要的事。我们的夫人决定拿她杀鸡儆猴。”（这位夫人是劳拉。）“那我们就拿她好好儆一儆。”“别拿细节烦我。现在滚出去！你们俩真碍眼。”

82ab731ac437.en: Arukia sells goods at the market
82ab731ac437.t: 阿露琪娅在集市上卖货

83e09358fffa.t: 第 15 卷 - 一局米纳里棋

83e18d310eed.en: They turn the corner to the restaurant. Magi takes out the key and hands it to Harry, looking away. "I did my part." Harry sees the bloodied Magi turn to leave with a sad expression. "Hey, pink adventurer, don't you want to come in and wash your clothes? You did heal me, right?" Magi, slightly blushing, points to the holes in her uniform. "I can't, or I'll wear them out even more." Harry, seeing her cute face: "I can make you supper too." Magi's stomach growls. She has no choice but to accept.
83e18d310eed.t: 他们拐过拐角来到餐馆。玛姬拿出钥匙递给哈利，眼睛看着别处。“我的事做完了。”哈利看到满身是血的玛姬带着悲伤的表情转身要走。“嘿，粉衣冒险者，你不想进来洗洗衣服吗？你治好了我，对吧？”玛姬脸微微一红，指着她制服上的破洞。“我不能，不然它们会更破。”哈利看着她可爱的脸：“我也可以给你做晚饭。”玛姬的肚子咕咕叫了起来。她只好接受了。

84106e826860.en: As the bloodied couple walks, people give them strange looks, mostly wondering what they did to end up like that. Rumors in the background: "Hey! That's a uniform from The Wood People Picker!" "That's one of the servers!" Harry tries to cover the restaurant's logo with his hand, but the uniform gives him away easily.
84106e826860.t: 这对满身是血的人走在路上，人们用奇怪的眼神看着他们，大多在想他们干了什么才落得这副样子。背景里的流言：“嘿！那是伍德·皮普尔·皮克的制服！”“那是那里的服务员之一！”哈利想用手遮住餐馆的标志，但制服还是很容易就暴露了他。

84509f079d81.en: A loud bang on the door. The Cruros prepare for battle. Coema: "Well, someone was smarter than us." The door opens, and a stranger leaps inside, straight at Coema; she doesn't flinch as the Cruros protect her. The stranger screams: "You fucking bitch! You lied! You used me!" Coema: "Who are you?"
84509f079d81.t: 门上一声巨响。克鲁罗们准备战斗。科埃玛：“好吧，有人比我们聪明。”门开了，一个陌生人跳了进来，直扑科埃玛；克鲁罗们保护着她，她纹丝不动。陌生人尖叫道：“你这个操蛋的贱人！你撒谎！你利用了我！”科埃玛：“你是谁？”

848b7f3eba95.en: Eori's friend comes in with tickets to Maiara's championship
848b7f3eba95.t: 埃奥丽的朋友拿着迈阿拉锦标赛的门票走了进来

84fe447d253c.en: Magi holds out her hand, interrupting his thoughts. "Let's go already." Harry hesitates a little, but she doesn't have her bow drawn on him anymore, so now she looks cute rather than frightening. "Don't forget your bag of balls."
84fe447d253c.t: 玛姬伸出手，打断了他的思绪。“我们走吧。”哈利有点犹豫，但她已经不再拿弓对着他了，所以现在她看起来可爱而不是吓人。“别忘了你那袋球。”

85f7ccc6f21b.en: In her quarters, Arukia puts the Bruntos to sleep on the floor
85f7ccc6f21b.t: 在她的住处，阿露琪娅让布伦托斯睡在地上

895b2782e793.en: Anger kicks in; Eori tries to step toward Coema, but the Cruros won't allow it. Coema: "You're not making this any easier. Will you settle down and listen if I tell you who took Harry from you?" Eori opens her eyes, holds herself back and clenches her fists. "Fine." "Agent Arukia, of the Red Winga." "Where is she?" "Putting herself out as bait as we speak. She's trying to redeem herself, just like Katsuki."
895b2782e793.t: 怒火上来了；埃奥丽想朝科埃玛走过去，但克鲁罗们不允许。科埃玛：“你这样只会让事情更难办。如果我告诉你是谁从你身边带走了哈利，你会冷静下来听吗？”埃奥丽睁开眼睛，克制住自己，攥紧拳头。“好吧。”“雷德温加的特工阿露琪娅。”“她在哪儿？”“就在我们说话的时候，她正在把自己当作诱饵放出去。她在试图赎罪，就像胜希一样。”

897407ba653d.en: Eiri: "I can't believe Neferteri lied to me like that too! Why didn't I catch on sooner? It's all my fault! If I hadn't made Harry sign the contract, none of this would have happened." Arukia says nothing. Coema sighs, stands up, and slaps the shit out of Eiri. "Get your Sanbi shit together! If you're so sad about her and this Harry feller, then do something about it!"
897407ba653d.t: 艾莉：“我不敢相信奈菲尔特丽也这样骗了我！我为什么没早点发现？这全是我的错！如果我没有让哈利签那份契约，这一切都不会发生。”阿露琪娅什么也没说。科埃玛叹了口气，站起来，狠狠地扇了艾莉一巴掌。“把你那桑比屎收拾好！如果你为她和这个叫哈利的家伙那么难过，那就做点什么！”

89cf7c587205.en: The Bruntos makes a mess, and she laughs. The woman of the house interrupts to bring her a new set of clothes in exchange for the old ones. Arukia says she doesn't have much money. They reply: neither do we.
89cf7c587205.t: 布伦托斯弄得一团糟，她笑了。这家的女主人进来打断了她们，拿来一套新衣服换她的旧衣服。阿露琪娅说她没什么钱。她们回答：我们也没有。

89d4577e03ea.en: Someone walks in. Emelia plays along and hands over the flower they want, while the bandits pretend to browse the flowers on their own, looking clearly suspicious. The customer asks Emelia if she needs help. Emelia plays it off: those two are after the same guy, and they're trying to one-up each other in everything. People joke with them; the bandits aren't sure how to react, and wait for the customer to leave.
89d4577e03ea.t: 有人走了进来。艾米莉娅配合着递上他们想要的花，而强盗们假装自己在看花，看起来明显很可疑。顾客问艾米莉娅需不需要帮忙。艾米莉娅搪塞过去：那两个人在追同一个男人，什么都想压对方一头。人们拿他们开玩笑；强盗们不知道该怎么反应，等着顾客离开。

8a8b3fc03e87.en: {WIP-eoriTeacher} asks Eori to come with her to fulfill a contract. Eori says she doesn't have time right now; the teacher says she'll simply fail her. Eori complies.
8a8b3fc03e87.t: {WIP-eoriTeacher} 让埃奥丽和她一起去履行一份契约。埃奥丽说她现在没时间；老师说那她就直接让她挂科。埃奥丽服从了。

8aa1f42bbaea.en: She thinks about what to do with it, fights with herself, and decides to keep it. It hugs her and climbs up onto her neck. Arukia isn't sure what to do, and stays kind of cold toward it. (Bruntos are in Beasts.)
8aa1f42bbaea.t: 她想着该拿它怎么办，和自己斗争了一番，决定留下它。它抱住她，爬上了她的脖子。阿露琪娅不知道该怎么办，对它有点冷淡。（布伦托斯见魔兽。）

8c158e58d4b4.en: Magi feels the pressure, but holds her stance, and approaches Harry with her bow drawn. Tears stream down his face. "I'm—sor—ry." He can barely get a word out, struggling just to breathe.
8c158e58d4b4.t: 玛姬感到了压力，但仍保持着姿势，拉着弓朝哈利走去。泪水从他脸上流下。“对——不——起。”他几乎说不出一个字，光是呼吸就很费劲了。

8c1664fbc56e.en: She uses the Create Shock spell on him. As Harry comes back to life with a huge gasp, Magi quickly readies her bow, arrow drawn on him. He cowers in fear. "Who are you?" "De—Desmond?" She draws further. "Who are you?"
8c1664fbc56e.t: 她对他使用了创造电击咒语。哈利猛地吸了一大口气活了过来，玛姬迅速准备好弓，箭对准了他。他吓得缩成一团。“你是谁？”“德——德斯蒙德？”她把弓拉得更满。“你是谁？”

8c4fd1135b4d.t: 埃奥丽无聊地看着比赛

8d7435ef8076.en: Arukia leaves the bar, followed by two people
8d7435ef8076.t: 阿露琪娅离开酒吧，有两个人跟着她

8d86fbbb8858.en: "His appearance barely changed!" Magi grabs the badge: Harry Sanbi. She touches the badge to him again, but it doesn't light up at all. She touches the fully healed, but dead, Harry. "What's going on?"
8d86fbbb8858.t: “他的外貌几乎没变！”玛姬抓起身份牌：哈利·桑比。她又把身份牌贴在他身上，但它一点也没亮。她摸了摸已经完全愈合、却死去的哈利。“这是怎么回事？”

8dc5afd2fa9e.en: The Homeegg final is intense, and so is Maiara's play. Maiara scores a goal; Eori is still bored. People celebrate as the game goes on, and Eori goes off to buy something.
8dc5afd2fa9e.t: 霍姆埃格决赛很激烈，迈阿拉的表现也很激烈。迈阿拉进了一球；埃奥丽还是很无聊。比赛继续进行，人们欢呼庆祝，埃奥丽去买东西了。

8de6f58b1cd8.t: 哈利又一次醒来，独自一人

8e6e6cb919b7.t: 第 4 弧 - 腥味的阴谋 · #HusbandOutWorld

914596199232.en: Arukia uses a body as a meat shield; two dying Cruros share the other bandit as theirs; four agents run toward them
914596199232.t: 阿露琪娅用一具身体当肉盾；两个垂死的克鲁罗共用另一个强盗当盾牌；四个特工朝他们跑来

9286227aa2b8.en: Hanako: "Damn. All right, fine. We know Desmond fought with someone after leaving the atelier, then took off running toward a guard post. That's all we know. We used the money he gave us to pay for town-crier calls for him. Now you need to get out if you're not going to buy something. Yosuke helped pay the town crier, but he's clamping down harder on us."
9286227aa2b8.t: 花子：“该死。好吧，行。我们知道德斯蒙德离开裁缝铺之后和某人打了一架，然后朝一个卫兵岗哨跑去。我们就知道这么多。我们用他给我们的钱付了城镇报信人去喊他。现在如果你们不买东西就得出去。洋介帮忙付了城镇报信人的钱，但他对我们管得更严了。”

93567d3f122b.en: She also gets a letter from Coema: stop being a little bitch, and think for yourself for once. Neferteri will only stop controlling you when she realizes you're a lost cause. Rebel, throw a temper tantrum, have fun! If you need some investment for that, get in touch, but be sure to follow through, or I'll be worse than Neferteri.
93567d3f122b.t: 她还收到了科埃玛的一封信：别再当个小贱人了，这次自己动动脑子。奈菲尔特丽只有在意识到你已经无药可救时才会停止控制你。造反吧，发脾气，玩得开心！如果你需要一些资金，就联系我，但一定要做到底，否则我会比奈菲尔特丽更糟。

936db2f1db3f.en: Eori pulls out the arrow and presses her hand over the hole. "You don't have to be so fucking jumpy, you know." Magi, feeling the weight of the conspiracy, nocks another arrow. "So you made Harry disappear?" "Why would I be here, then?" Magi draws further. "To keep me from spreading the word that you were having—intimate relations with a commoner." "I cared about that at one point. Now I just want Harry back. You gonna stand there all day, or are you gonna heal me?"
936db2f1db3f.t: 埃奥丽拔出箭，用手按住伤口。“你知道，你不用他妈的这么一惊一乍。”玛姬感到了阴谋的分量，又搭上一支箭。“所以是你让哈利消失的？”“那我为什么还在这里？”玛姬把弓拉得更满。“为了阻止我到处说你和一个平民有——亲密关系。”“我曾经在乎过那个。现在我只想要回哈利。你打算在那儿站一整天，还是给我治伤？”

93740c533485.t: 第 1 章 - 加倍努力

948b6c49b632.en: Morika has a prod heating in the fire. Arukia is chained up, with stab wounds in her belly. Morika gets ready to stab again, but Neferteri raises a hand to stop him; Morika holds back and carefully places the prod back in the fire.
948b6c49b632.t: 莫里卡把一根烙铁放在火里烧着。阿露琪娅被锁着，肚子上有刺伤。莫里卡准备再刺一下，但奈菲尔特丽举手制止了他；莫里卡停了下来，小心地把烙铁放回火里。

949fc832a91a.en: Arukia walks out, remembering doing something like this before. She takes off running, and the people following her do the same. She runs as if in desperation, but toward a predetermined spot.
949fc832a91a.t: 阿露琪娅走了出去，想起以前也做过这样的事。她拔腿就跑，跟着她的人也跑了起来。她跑得像是走投无路，但其实是朝着一个预先定好的地点。

94b122f4861b.en: She can't even face her own parents, if they're even still alive after what she did to the Red Winga. She knew where they were and what the Red Winga could do, but she still went through with it, and fled it all. She hoes even harder, and then hears a cry.
94b122f4861b.t: 她甚至无法面对自己的父母，如果在她对雷德温加做了那些事之后他们还活着的话。她知道他们在哪里，也知道雷德温加会做什么，但她还是这么做了，然后逃离了一切。她更用力地锄着地，然后听到了一声哭叫。

96f83aca6d2a.en: Magi and Eori make their way back to Sanbi
96f83aca6d2a.t: 玛姬和埃奥丽返回桑比

972bc58545e9.t: 阿露琪娅发现了一只受伤的布伦托斯

97648d9eb19b.en: Arukia: Someone was calling my name, and now this? Does Eori want Harry back this badly? Could this be my ticket out of the Red Winga? She grabs her money pouch: she can either buy a nari gel to stay on the island, or use the money to go back to Sanbi. She looks at her baby, then at her ragged clothes. They leave without buying anything.
97648d9eb19b.t: 阿露琪娅：有人在喊我的名字，现在又是这个？埃奥丽这么想要回哈利吗？这会是我摆脱雷德温加的门票吗？她抓起钱袋：她要么买一份纳里凝胶留在岛上，要么用这笔钱回桑比。她看看她的宝宝，又看看自己破烂的衣服。她们什么也没买就离开了。

97755385fee5.en: Yosuke bangs his metal ladle on something to wake everyone. He bonks Dalila on the head to get her up; Harry looks at the open window.
97755385fee5.t: 洋介用他的金属勺子敲着什么东西，把大家叫醒。他敲了敲达莉拉的头让她起来；哈利看着打开的窗户。

97f7287d83b2.en: She thinks about things: her life, her father, and so on. Then Harry appears in her mind. She wakes up, trying to clear her head, but his smile when he invited her in keeps nagging at her. Then Morika, and Eori. Did Eori really love some random guy from the Sanbi slums?
97f7287d83b2.t: 她想着各种事：她的生活、她的父亲，等等。然后哈利出现在她的脑海里。她醒过来，想让脑子清醒一点，但他邀请她进去时的笑容一直萦绕着她。然后是莫里卡，还有埃奥丽。埃奥丽真的爱上了桑比贫民窟里某个随便的家伙吗？

9829c5ad9c27.en: Magi sees how many balls are in it. "What do you want from me?" "Help—me find Harry. You know what he looks like." Magi eyes the inviting bag. "P—post a quest, and we'll talk about it!" "I can't fucking do that! Mom will realize what I'm trying to do!" "Mom? You mean the queen of Sanbi?" "Who else, you dumb bitch? I'm trying to break free of her grip! I'm sick of this shit!" Magi: "All right. Fine. Let's go back to the restaurant. Just remember, he was called Desmond."
9829c5ad9c27.t: 玛姬看到里面有多少球。“你想从我这里得到什么？”“帮——帮我找到哈利。你知道他长什么样。”玛姬盯着那个诱人的袋子。“发——发布一个任务，我们再谈！”“我他妈不能那么做！妈妈会发现我想干什么的！”“妈妈？你是说桑比的王后？”“还能是谁，你这个蠢婊子？我想摆脱她的控制！我受够这堆狗屁了！”玛姬：“好吧。行。我们回餐馆去。只是记住，他叫德斯蒙德。”

99c5a4cdaecf.en: Coema plans an assault to rescue Harry and Arukia. She sends word to Eiri and Sora to declare Eori missing and call an emergency meeting, while the rest of them split up to get both Harry and Arukia out, and imprison Neferteri.
99c5a4cdaecf.t: 科埃玛计划发动一次突袭来营救哈利和阿露琪娅。她派人通知艾莉和索拉宣布埃奥丽失踪并召开紧急会议，而其他人则分头行动，把哈利和阿露琪娅都救出来，并囚禁奈菲尔特丽。

99f95311890c.en: A whack to the back of the neck drops one of the bandits forward, and soon after, the other. A Cruro gives a thumbs-up with a small grunt, but then another Cruro squeals in pain: an arrow has perforated its lung. They turn, but can't see anything. Arukia leaps forward and uses one of the bodies as a shield.
99f95311890c.t: 后颈上一记重击让一个强盗向前倒下，很快另一个也倒下了。一个克鲁罗轻轻哼了一声，竖起大拇指，但接着另一个克鲁罗痛苦地尖叫起来：一支箭射穿了它的肺。他们转过身，却什么也看不见。阿露琪娅向前一扑，用其中一具身体当盾牌。

9a7bc8950aec.en: She bows and starts off, then weighs her green bag, opens it and peeks inside: several small Fost stones, about the size of a piece of gum. She turns around. "Did I drop some, by any chance?" The older lady looks away. "I'm sure they're all there, sweetie." Then she looks back. "Unless… are you saying we're bandits?" Magi feels an ominous presence from them. Someone at the back: "What do you say? Let's call it a rescue fee?"
9a7bc8950aec.t: 她鞠了一躬准备离开，然后掂了掂她的绿色袋子，打开往里看：几块口香糖大小的小福斯特石。她转过身。“我是不是碰巧掉了一些？”那位年长的女士移开了目光。“我敢肯定都在那儿，亲爱的。”然后她又看了回来。“除非……你是说我们是强盗？”玛姬感到他们身上有一种不祥的气息。后面有人说：“你们说呢？就算是救援费吧？”

9b3e5db85e30.en: Magi looks at the gore, gets irritated and breaks out of her shell. "Why don't we just capture him instead?" Eori: "Morika would never talk. He's her perfect pawn, blindly following her around." Ryo eats his nari gel and starts transforming. "He's taking her away! Let's go." The others follow suit.
9b3e5db85e30.t: 玛姬看着血腥的场面，烦躁起来，打破了自己的沉默。“我们为什么不直接抓住他？”埃奥丽：“莫里卡永远不会开口的。他是她完美的棋子，盲目地跟着她。”亮吃下他的纳里凝胶，开始变形。“他要把她带走了！我们走。”其他人也跟着照做。

9bc357915d7b.en: An older lady scolds her as she hands over her things. "Lady! You need to be more careful! There are bandits around!" The girl in pink takes her bow, attaches it to her backpack and puts it on. "I'm sorry!"
9bc357915d7b.t: 一位年长的女士把东西递给她时训斥她。“姑娘！你得更小心点！附近有强盗！”粉衣女孩接过弓，把它系在背包上背好。“对不起！”

a068e9eca10a.en: His hand freezes. "Morika Tolerideme. An adventurer protecting Princess Eori." Eori, now on Magi's side: "What the fuck are you doing here?" Morika slowly takes out his badge. "You're an invaluable target for kidnapping." Eori looks at the lit-up badge, clearly saying Morika. "Oh! So you're gonna kidnap me instead?" She remembers being kidnapped by Namia and Posaqui. "You know what? You can all go fuck yourselves. I'm not her little bitch anymore!" She walks off, away from Morika.
a068e9eca10a.t: 他的手僵住了。“莫里卡·托勒里德梅。保护埃奥丽公主的冒险者。”埃奥丽现在站到了玛姬那边：“你他妈在这里干什么？”莫里卡慢慢掏出他的身份牌。“您是一个极具价值的绑架目标。”埃奥丽看着亮起来的身份牌，上面清楚地写着莫里卡。“哦！所以你要来绑架我？”她想起了被娜米娅和波萨基绑架的事。“你知道吗？你们都可以去操你们自己。我不再是她的小贱人了！”她走开了，离莫里卡远远的。

a0ba6b72fc70.en: The clerk hands her about 2 Pearls; Magi asleep in a seat with her backpack and bow
a0ba6b72fc70.t: 文员递给她大约 2 颗珀尔；玛姬抱着背包和弓在座位上睡着了

a0e663a3037c.en: Desmond leans back. "You okay? You just passed out cold." Magi glares at him. "Don't touch me!" "DESMOND! STOP FLIRTING AND CLEAN THIS SHIT UP!" Rimir's scream from the kitchen door breaks the awkwardness filling the room. "Sorry, pink adventurer. I'll grab you another drink. You can stay here until I finish cleaning up the floor."
a0e663a3037c.t: 德斯蒙德往后靠了靠。“你还好吗？你刚才一下子昏过去了。”玛姬瞪着他。“别碰我！”“德斯蒙德！别调情了，把这堆烂摊子收拾干净！”里米尔从厨房门口的吼声打破了房间里弥漫的尴尬。“抱歉，粉衣冒险者。我再给你拿杯喝的。你可以待在这里，等我把地板打扫完。”

a16e52fefa20.en: As Eori walks away, Morika glances at her, puts his badge away, and looks at Harry, looking pretty dead, and at Magi, frozen, not quite getting how a princess could say something like that. He takes out a pouch of balls and tosses it at Harry's feet. "Apologies for Princess Eori's behavior. She mistook you for someone she knew."
a16e52fefa20.t: 埃奥丽走开时，莫里卡瞥了她一眼，收起身份牌，看了看看起来已经死透了的哈利，又看了看僵在原地、不太明白一个公主怎么会说出那种话的玛姬。他掏出一袋球，扔到哈利脚边。“为埃奥丽公主的行为道歉。她把你错当成了她认识的人。”

a2e87f72ca6e.en: On the wagon, Magi falls asleep on Eori's shoulder, and Eori slaps her awake. That drives them further apart, since Magi hides that she has narcolepsy.
a2e87f72ca6e.t: 在马车上，玛姬靠在埃奥丽的肩上睡着了，埃奥丽一巴掌把她打醒。这让她们的关系更疏远了，因为玛姬隐瞒了自己有嗜睡症。

a331c4fa1d66.en: Magi, nervous, at the corner, watching the building; the door is closed, but there's still light inside
a331c4fa1d66.t: 玛姬紧张地站在街角，盯着那栋楼；门关着，但里面还亮着灯

a36da4310d64.en: Magi at the Embassy at the crack of dawn; the clerk has a copy of the badge
a36da4310d64.t: 天刚亮，玛姬就在大使馆；文员手里有一份身份牌的副本

a475e6d40d1f.en: She goes downstairs to search for Harry, but only finds Arukia's body against the wall. Her anger builds toward Arukia for everything she did to Harry, and to her. She drags the body downstairs, adds more nari gel, and tries to revive her. Nothing. Eori punches Arukia in the chest, breaking her ribs, and keeps punching as tears stream from her eyes.
a475e6d40d1f.t: 她下楼去找哈利，却只在墙边找到了阿露琪娅的尸体。她对阿露琪娅的怒火越烧越旺，为了她对哈利、对她所做的一切。她把尸体拖下楼，加了更多的纳里凝胶，试着复活她。什么都没发生。埃奥丽一拳打在阿露琪娅的胸口，打断了她的肋骨，一边流着泪一边不停地打。

a67df01aa37b.en: They realize Harry must be alive somewhere, and they need to talk with Coema to find out where. Sora argues it's pointless: the search quest never did anything, and Coema hasn't found Arukia yet. Eiri: "We must try! Can you imagine what Harry went through after he was kidnapped, right after starting his job as the Sanbi Eye?"
a67df01aa37b.t: 她们意识到哈利一定还活在某个地方，她们需要和科埃玛谈谈，才能知道在哪里。索拉争辩说这毫无意义：搜寻任务从来没起过作用，而科埃玛也还没找到阿露琪娅。艾莉：“我们必须试试！你能想象哈利刚开始当桑比之眼就被绑架之后经历了什么吗？”

a75bb553a801.en: A construction guy walks in, looking turned on. Ryo laughs. "Damn! This place is gonna do nicely. How can I help ya?" "We're finishing prepping the walls. Have you decided on the color scheme?" "Crap, I forgot to ask you about that." Katsumi decides on a name on the spot, {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}, plus the color scheme. Ryo: "There's your answer."
a75bb553a801.t: 一个建筑工人走了进来，看起来也被撩起来了。亮笑了。“该死！这个地方会生意兴隆的。有什么能帮你的？”“我们快把墙准备好了。你们决定配色方案了吗？”“糟了，我忘了问你这个。”胜美当场决定了一个名字 {WIP-katsumiWhorehouse}，以及配色方案。亮：“这就是你的答案。”

a8bf0e507072.en: Looking at herself in the mirror, it dawns on her that Harry is still out there. She could have gotten some information out of that fake Harry about where he found a Harry-based nari gel, but she was too angry to think of it. She breaks something in anger, which makes her even more furious. "Now I have to go through every single nari gel vendor to find out where it was made…"
a8bf0e507072.t: 照着镜子，她突然意识到哈利还在外面。她本可以从那个假哈利那里套出一些情报，问出他是从哪里弄到以哈利为原型的纳里凝胶的，但她当时太生气了，没想到这一点。她气得砸了点东西，这让她更加愤怒了。“现在我得一个一个地去问每一个纳里凝胶小贩，查出它是在哪里做的……”

a981aa55fb02.en: Harry helps them set up shop while Dalila, Yosuke and Rimir cook; Magi somewhere in the background
a981aa55fb02.t: 达莉拉、洋介和里米尔做饭时，哈利帮他们布置摊位；玛姬在背景里的某个地方

aa2c38b26298.en: She'll use something to test his soul, and see that it doesn't work. She'll refuse to believe it, while the people around her use it as proof that she's misbehaving, and let Harry go free.
aa2c38b26298.t: 她会用某种东西测试他的灵魂，发现它不起作用。她会拒绝相信，而她周围的人会把这当作她行为不端的证据，放哈利自由。

aabc0163f230.en: Eori, her appearance changed with nari gels, in a cheap room
aabc0163f230.t: 用纳里凝胶改变了外貌的埃奥丽待在一个便宜的房间里

aafa005e528f.en: Eiri: "So what do I do? Should I talk to Itagiba?" Coema shoves a snack in her mouth. "No. He'll get drunk and say something that gives us away. You two stay in the dark until Eori wreaks havoc." "Eori? But she's in Forway." "Not for long. She'll show up back in Sanbi any time now." "How do you know?" "Just as you and Sora saw those Harry-feller nari gels, Eori must have seen them too."
aafa005e528f.t: 艾莉：“那我该怎么办？我该和伊塔吉巴谈谈吗？”科埃玛往嘴里塞了一口零食。“不行。他会喝醉，说出些暴露我们的话。你们俩先什么都别管，等埃奥丽大闹一场。”“埃奥丽？可她在福威。”“不会太久了。她随时都会出现在桑比。”“你怎么知道？”“就像你和索拉看到了那些哈利家伙的纳里凝胶一样，埃奥丽一定也看到了。”

ad2f464ec672.en: The next morning, Magi stands in front of The Wood People Picker
ad2f464ec672.t: 第二天早上，玛姬站在伍德·皮普尔·皮克门前

ae56032acc3c.en: "Going to sign another? I have a few." Magi: "Whatever's safest, for the most money." "More roadwork, I presume?" Magi nods, holding the two Pearls. She pulls out her badge, makes it light up, and hands the two Pearls back. "Can you please add these to the Blue-Flower-Red-Bone guild?" The clerk doesn't take them. Instead, he smiles. "I'll get the contracts arranged. Please excuse me."
ae56032acc3c.t: “要再签一份吗？我这里有几份。”玛姬：“最安全、钱最多的那种。”“我猜又是修路的活？”玛姬点点头，握着两颗珀尔。她拿出身份牌，让它亮起来，把两颗珀尔递了回去。“能请你把这些加到布卢·弗劳尔·雷德·博恩公会里吗？”文员没有接。相反，他笑了。“我去把契约安排好。请稍等。”

af7df03ae7ab.en: To Magi, Eori seems kind of controlling, and antisocial. She wonders if Harry running away from her was a sign that something bad happened between them.
af7df03ae7ab.t: 在玛姬看来，埃奥丽有点控制欲强，而且孤僻。她怀疑哈利逃离她是不是说明他们之间发生了什么不好的事。

af8cf250a0df.en: Eori has an altercation with Morika, who has basically put her under house arrest
af8cf250a0df.t: 埃奥丽和莫里卡起了冲突，莫里卡基本上把她软禁了

b04499d5cbd7.en: Hanako clears her throat as she comes closer. "Then what are you doing in his room, drenched in sweat?" Magi looks at her damp clothes, and her face turns redder. "It's not what you're thinking! I passed out!" "Ohhhhhh—he's that good?" Magi stares back, not understanding.
b04499d5cbd7.t: 花子一边走近一边清了清嗓子。“那你浑身是汗地在他房间里干什么？”玛姬看着自己湿漉漉的衣服，脸更红了。“不是你想的那样！我昏过去了！”“哦——他有那么厉害？”玛姬回瞪着她，没听懂。

b24168a24ddd.en: Hanako and Mimi tell Magi to get fucked for not helping find Desmond. Magi says she's investigating what happened to him now. Hanako probes her, but she dodges.
b24168a24ddd.t: 花子和咪咪因为玛姬不帮忙找德斯蒙德，叫她滚蛋。玛姬说她现在正在调查他出了什么事。花子追问她，但她回避了。

b3011bcf594e.en: They leave. Magi asks what Eori's relationship with him is. Eori says they were lovers, fleeing Neferteri's grasp. Magi takes it in, but something doesn't feel right.
b3011bcf594e.t: 她们离开了。玛姬问埃奥丽和他是什么关系。埃奥丽说他们是恋人，在逃离奈菲尔特丽的掌控。玛姬听着，但有什么地方感觉不对。

b4984983c636.en: The Cruros see how smart the idea is, but as they try it, another arrow hits them. Arukia, unarmed and at a dead end, desperately looks for a way out, when one of the Cruros dying on the ground coughs up blood. She sees he's carrying a small knife. "Give me his knife."
b4984983c636.t: 克鲁罗们看出这个主意有多聪明，但他们刚要这么做，又有一支箭射中了他们。手无寸铁、走投无路的阿露琪娅拼命寻找出路，这时一个躺在地上奄奄一息的克鲁罗咳出了血。她看到他带着一把小刀。“把他的刀给我。”

b56bff2eb24b.en: Ryo is mesmerized by her ability to eat Barinas like no one else; Katsuki is so focused she doesn't even offer him any. "You like Barinas that much?" Katsuki, frog juice dripping down her chin, nods and keeps going.
b56bff2eb24b.t: 亮被她吃巴里纳的能力迷住了，谁都比不上；胜希吃得那么专注，连一个都没分给他。“你这么喜欢巴里纳？”胜希下巴上滴着青蛙汁，点点头，继续吃。

b62cd02e5b78.en: Ryo: "The Cruros. See how the share of Cruros in the bar is higher than out in the street?" Katsuki starts noticing it, and sure enough, once you pay attention, it looks like a Cruro festival is going on. Ryo: "Lesson of the day: you need to know people's tactics, and that lets you see what's going on without asking a single question. Granted, it's a bet, but I'm fairly sure who's behind this one. Follow me."
b62cd02e5b78.t: 亮：“克鲁罗。看到酒吧里克鲁罗的比例比街上高吗？”胜希开始注意到了，果然，一旦你留意，看起来就像在举办一场克鲁罗节。亮：“今天的课：你需要了解人们的策略，这样你不用问一个问题就能看出发生了什么。当然，这是在赌，但我相当确定这次是谁在背后。跟我来。”

b64b3dc833f7.en: Eori: I can't believe she's taking that bitch's body to my house! Anger flares. She swoops in, crashing through a window on the upper floor. "Morika" (actually {WIP-morikaDecoy}) climbs the stairs.
b64b3dc833f7.t: 埃奥丽：我不敢相信她把那个贱人的尸体带到我家来了！怒火燃了起来。她俯冲下去，撞破了楼上的一扇窗户。“莫里卡”（其实是 {WIP-morikaDecoy}）爬上了楼梯。

b7a4bd08ee56.en: Magi startles awake, with no idea where she is, her head pounding. Her backpack and bow are missing, but searching frantically, she finds them right by the bed. Her clothes are damp, but the warmth of the bed makes her feel better.
b7a4bd08ee56.t: 玛姬猛地惊醒，不知道自己在哪里，头痛欲裂。她的背包和弓不见了，但她慌乱地找了一番，发现它们就在床边。她的衣服还湿着，但床的温暖让她感觉好多了。

b7a824acd3ca.en: Assistant: "I heard all about it in the letter. You two are indeed quite cute. With that in mind, here's a gift I bought." She brings out a kimono-like outfit for each of them. Ryo: "Actually, I forgot to tell you: only Katsumi will be running this place. Katsuki wants to travel with me instead." "You want to travel with her instead. I know how this goes."
b7a824acd3ca.t: 助手：“信里我都听说了。你们俩确实很可爱。考虑到这一点，这是我买的一份礼物。”她给她们每人拿出一套像和服一样的衣服。亮：“其实，我忘了告诉你：只有胜美会经营这个地方。胜希想和我一起旅行。”“是你想和她一起旅行吧。我知道这是怎么回事。”

b8b3d4594570.en: Tons of food are ready, and they celebrate. Yosuke tells them to rest well: the wagons arrive at Sunnalow to pick up the food, and they'd better be ready!
b8b3d4594570.t: 大量的食物准备好了，他们庆祝起来。洋介叫他们好好休息：马车会在苏纳洛来取食物，他们最好准备好！

b8ca6ba0b6db.en: Magi, holding the key, looks at the dead Harry and gives him the last bit of Nari Refresher she has. Harry loses some weight as his body recovers, but the only change in his appearance is his hair turning black again.
b8ca6ba0b6db.t: 玛姬拿着钥匙，看着死去的哈利，把她身上最后一点纳里里弗雷舍给了他。哈利的身体恢复时瘦了一些，但他外貌上唯一的变化是头发又变回了黑色。

b9526b14c9a3.en: Harry eats a nari gel to improve his eyes. It hurts. Magi keeps to herself.
b9526b14c9a3.t: 哈利吃了一份改善视力的纳里凝胶。很痛。玛姬一言不发。

b96e4cff3c38.en: Arukia, hiding somewhere in Endlessfog, hoes in the sun. She stops for a second to watch a passing boat and wonders how long she's been here. Maybe it's for the better: no more Red Winga, no more Harry, no more anyone. Just her.
b96e4cff3c38.t: 阿露琪娅躲在恩德莱斯福格的某个地方，在阳光下锄地。她停下来片刻，看着一艘经过的船，想着自己在这里待了多久。也许这样更好：不再有雷德温加，不再有哈利，不再有任何人。只有她自己。

baf78203b00c.en: Coema: "Eori, you're not the only one looking for Harry." Ryo: "We all have our reasons, but we want to help him too." Tears well up in Eori's eyes. "Harry is mine! He was mine from the beginning!" Coema: "But does he want to be yours?"
baf78203b00c.t: 科埃玛：“埃奥丽，你不是唯一一个在找哈利的人。”亮：“我们都有各自的理由，但我们也想帮他。”泪水在埃奥丽的眼眶里打转。“哈利是我的！他从一开始就是我的！”科埃玛：“可他想成为你的吗？”

bb4a6a5e5771.en: Her heart races thinking of all the money she'd get. Then she remembers something from back in Blood, when she applied to the guild to become a Pearl: she can borrow a suspect's badge for up to a week, but if she loses it, she pays ten times the price or is forced to work until the debt is paid off, plus other fees if she takes more than a week. (The Missing Person rule: only for adventurers investigating with a good lead.) She decides she'll do it.
bb4a6a5e5771.t: 一想到她能拿到的那些钱，她的心就怦怦直跳。然后她想起了在布拉德时的一件事，那时她向公会申请成为珀尔级：她可以借用嫌疑人的身份牌最多一周，但如果弄丢了，就得赔十倍的价钱，或者被迫工作直到还清债务，如果超过一周还要付其他费用。（失踪人口规则：只适用于有可靠线索的调查中的冒险者。）她决定这么做。

bba0f92a584e.en: They're carrying something when they get hurt in a landslide. Arukia shields the baby Bruntos, but breaks her ribs, and more.
bba0f92a584e.t: 她们扛着什么东西，在一次山体滑坡中受了伤。阿露琪娅护住了布伦托斯宝宝，但断了肋骨，还有别的伤。

bc7e2c1df249.en: A poke on her cheek wakes her: the same clerk, handing her a measly two Pearls. "Hey, miss. You didn't return all the stones." She holds out her hands and he places them there, then shows her the contract: she got more Fost stones from them than she brought back. Magi clutches the two Pearls to her chest, holding back her tears. The clerk waves the contract; she signs it.
bc7e2c1df249.t: 脸颊上一戳把她弄醒了：还是那个文员，递给她区区两颗珀尔。“嘿，小姐。你没有把所有的石头都还回来。”她伸出双手，他把珀尔放在上面，然后给她看契约：她从他们那里拿的福斯特石比她带回来的多。玛姬把两颗珀尔紧紧抱在胸前，忍住眼泪。文员晃了晃契约；她签了字。

bcc7a0f5770c.en: Eiri: "We want to help him." "By doing what, exactly?" They don't know; Sora talks about asking around. Coema: "I'll take care of that. I have a better job for you two: feed Neferteri false information, and don't let her find out I'm behind Eori's escapade. Though I wouldn't be surprised if she's put two and two together."
bcc7a0f5770c.t: 艾莉：“我们想帮他。”“具体怎么帮？”她们不知道；索拉说要四处打听。科埃玛：“这个我来处理。我给你们俩一份更好的差事：给奈菲尔特丽提供假情报，别让她发现埃奥丽的胡闹背后是我。不过就算她已经把这些联系起来了，我也不会感到惊讶。”

bde0f66cfe1c.t: 第 3 章 - 旧日情谊

be83de6a5a02.t: 第 1 章 - 拨动阿露琪娅的心弦

beaab2781025.en: Arukia looks at Harry, then back at Neferteri. "Why are you trying to defend against Forway? The Prosperity Treaty exists for a reason." "Until it doesn't. It's a piece of paper, backed by the promises of men and women, which turn into backstabbing over the simplest arguments."
beaab2781025.t: 阿露琪娅看看哈利，又看回奈菲尔特丽。“你为什么要抵御福威？《繁荣条约》的存在是有原因的。”“直到它不存在的那一天。它只是一张纸，靠男男女女的承诺撑着，而那些承诺会因为最简单的争执变成背后捅刀子。”

beb263296a34.en: Her friend ({WIP-eoriRoommate}) comes into the room with tickets to Maiara's championship. Eori snaps at her, but the girl snaps right back, showing who's boss. They argue, and in the end the friend wins: Eori lets her win before she flips her shit and kills her on the spot.
beb263296a34.t: 她的朋友（{WIP-eoriRoommate}）拿着迈阿拉锦标赛的门票走进房间。埃奥丽冲她发火，但那个女孩毫不示弱地回击，表明了谁说了算。她们争吵起来，最后朋友赢了：埃奥丽在自己失控、当场杀了她之前让她赢了。

bee0b5c43fdf.en: Chapter 1 - If only I had Bagarisa Power
bee0b5c43fdf.t: 第 1 章 - 要是我有巴加里萨之力就好了

bf2cfed8a03e.en: Arukia is about to pass out when he suddenly goes limp and falls forward, hitting his head next to hers. She gasps and pushes the dead body aside. Four more Cruros appear to help her, looking battered from a fight.
bf2cfed8a03e.t: 阿露琪娅快要昏过去时，他突然软了下来，向前倒去，头撞在她的头旁边。她喘着气，把尸体推到一边。又有四个克鲁罗出现来帮她，看起来刚打完一仗，伤痕累累。

bf7f37100674.en: "My Queen! I have urgent news!" someone calls from the door. Neferteri goes on: "Whoever ordered you to attack my daughter did so over a petty argument. I am simply using my leverage to protect my daughter, and the citizens of the Sanbi Kingdom, against the likes of you." Arukia: "And I'm gonna protect myself from the likes of you." "That's unfortunate. Morika, please continue."
bf7f37100674.t: “我的王后！我有紧急消息！”有人在门口喊道。奈菲尔特丽继续说：“不管是谁命令你攻击我的女儿，都是因为一场小小的争执。我只是在利用我的筹码，保护我的女儿和桑比王国的市民，免受你们这种人的伤害。”阿露琪娅：“而我要保护我自己，免受你这种人的伤害。”“那可真不幸。莫里卡，请继续。”

bf80d442b824.t: 奈菲尔特丽和一个信使

bfc003618e06.en: "You think I only care about money? Honey. You really don't know me after all." Coema stands and spreads her arms. "Money is a tool for me to drink the tears of my enemies. Now, let's feast on Neferteri's tears." Ryo laughs. "Fair game. I'm in." Eori smirks. Magi doesn't look pleased. "Do you all think this is just a joke?" Coema understands where she's coming from, and acknowledges it: it's Neferteri playing games, but this time she's taken it too far, playing with matters she doesn't understand.
bfc003618e06.t: “你以为我只在乎钱？亲爱的。你终究还是不了解我。”科埃玛站起来，张开双臂。“钱是我用来喝敌人眼泪的工具。现在，我们来享用奈菲尔特丽的眼泪吧。”亮笑了。“公平。我加入。”埃奥丽得意地笑了。玛姬看起来不太高兴。“你们都觉得这只是个玩笑吗？”科埃玛理解她的立场，也承认了这一点：这是奈菲尔特丽在玩把戏，但这次她玩得太过火了，在玩弄她不理解的东西。

c08a042d0f6d.en: They argue about Soul research being futile and dangerous. The teacher realizes what Eori is after. "You think you're the only one who wants to bring back a loved one? We all did! But the soul doesn't care!"
c08a042d0f6d.t: 她们争论灵魂研究是徒劳而危险的。老师意识到了埃奥丽的目的。“你以为只有你想把心爱的人带回来吗？我们都想过！但灵魂不在乎！”

c1c3acc4df69.en: Magi, late morning, follows another wagon; no more Morika, just a random guy with a sword and a wagon full of things
c1c3acc4df69.t: 上午晚些时候，玛姬跟着另一辆马车；不再有莫里卡，只有一个带着剑的随便什么人和一车东西

c1eb0cfae922.en: Ryo and Coema hug, Katsuki at his side (both in their normal appearance); a few Cruros around
c1eb0cfae922.t: 亮和科埃玛拥抱，胜希在他身边（两人都是本来的样子）；周围有几个克鲁罗

c3ef81f595f7.en: Someone comes up behind Harry with a knife at his back. "Say anything, and I'll kill you." Harry defends himself, gets his clothes slashed and takes off running, but the attacker chases him down and slashes him. Harry tries to fight, but it's all in vain as a paralyzing poison takes over. He sees Eori's face, and wakes up.
c3ef81f595f7.t: 有人从哈利身后走上来，用一把刀抵着他的背。“敢出声，我就杀了你。”哈利自卫，衣服被划破了，拔腿就跑，但袭击者追上来砍伤了他。哈利试图反抗，但一切都是徒劳，一种麻痹毒药占据了他的身体。他看到了埃奥丽的脸，然后醒了过来。

c46cd2162445.en: He leads the pink adventurer to a table in the corner, looks around suspiciously, then speaks loudly: "I'm Desmond! How can I serve you today?" Then, quieter: "You're supposed to at least buy something, but don't tell anybody, or I'll be in trouble."
c46cd2162445.t: 他把粉衣冒险者带到角落里的一张桌子旁，警惕地看了看四周，然后大声说：“我是德斯蒙德！今天有什么可以为您效劳的？”接着又小声说：“你至少应该买点东西，但别告诉任何人，不然我就有麻烦了。”

c4ce65608f29.en: Eori drops her drink, rushes at him and tackles him to the ground. Harry, realizing who it is, puts his hand on her shoulder and tries to push her away while she forces herself on top of him for a kiss.
c4ce65608f29.t: 埃奥丽扔下饮料，冲向他，把他扑倒在地。哈利意识到是谁后，把手放在她的肩上，想把她推开，而她硬压到他身上要吻他。

c53fc66986c9.en: Someone finds them and offers Arukia a Nari Refresher. She says no, but too late: it's given to her, and she heals. The baby monkey looks at her, not quite understanding, but when it smells her, it hugs her.
c53fc66986c9.t: 有人发现了她们，给了阿露琪娅一份纳里里弗雷舍。她说不要，但太晚了：已经给她用上了，她痊愈了。小猴子看着她，不太明白，但当它闻了闻她之后，就抱住了她。

c55d92933002.en: Magi, Eori (in a fake body), Ryo and a few Cruros prepare to ambush the house
c55d92933002.t: 玛姬、埃奥丽（用着假身体）、亮和几个克鲁罗准备伏击那栋房子

c5c83cebf2d8.en: Morika comes downstairs with food and forces it down Harry's throat. "You're nothing but a failed experiment. Now do as you're told, and serve your purpose."
